title: High performance Stingray
background_knowledge:
高能天体物理（High Energy Astrophysics）主要研究宇宙中涉及极端物理条件（如强引力场、高温、高能粒子）的天体，如黑洞吸积盘、中子星、伽马射线暴等。这类天体系统通常表现出剧烈的时域变化（Variability），时间尺度跨度极大，从毫秒级的准周期振荡（QPOs）到年际尺度的爆发与宁静态转变。
\n为了理解这些快速变化的物理机制，**时域分析（Time Series Analysis）**是核心研究手段。最基础的数学工具是**傅里叶分析（Fourier Analysis）**，包括功率谱密度（PSD）、交叉谱（Cross Spectrum）、相干性分析以及用于研究非线性耦合的双谱分析。传统的分析工具往往局限于静态数据或小规模数据集，难以应对现代X射线天文台（如Chandra, XMM-Newton, NICER, eXTP等）产生的海量光子计数数据。为此，开源软件栈（如Python的stingray）应运而生，它不仅封装了标准的频域分析方法，还集成了脉冲星数据拟合、蒙特卡洛模拟以及参数统计模型，构成了高能时域天文学的基础设施。
contribution:
- **代码鲁棒性与性能基准测试**：针对最新版本的 `stingray` 库进行了全面的性能评估与鲁棒性测试，重点考察其在不同数据规模下的行为模式，旨在确立其在高能天体物理数据分析中的可靠性基准。
- **大规模数据处理优化**：针对数据集大小**超过随机存取存储器（RAM）** 的物理限制这一场景，识别并重构了计算耗时最长的傅里叶分析算法。通过实现**并行化版本**的算法，显著提升了软件处理海量X射线观测数据的能力，解决了内存溢出与计算瓶颈问题。
- **GPU加速可行性探索**：针对**小数据集**场景（通常对延迟敏感或需高频迭代），深入调研了将关键计算函数移植到 **GPU（图形处理单元）** 的潜力。研究指出，通过GPU并行计算架构的引入，可进一步优化小样本傅里叶变换及谱分析的响应速度，为实时或准实时分析提供了技术路径。
summary: X-ray astrophysical objects show variability on a wide range of timescales, i.e. from fractions of second to years. The open-source Python library stingray is able to perform time series analyses with a focus on high-energy astrophysics. Comprising the most commonly used Fourier analyses techniques, it also supports a range of additional extensions able to analyse pulsar data, simulate data sets and perform statistical modelling. With the latest release of the code, new Fourier methods and support for additional missions have been implemented, making Stingray more easily adaptable and extendable to other use cases. In this paper we focus on testing the performance and robustness of the latest version of stingray . We consider the possible different behaviour of the code when dealing with data sets smaller or larger than the RAM. We address the problem of dealing with large data sets and implemented parallel versions of the slowest methods in this regime. For small data sets, we investigate the possibility of a porting in GPU of key functions of the code.

title: GRINTA: a new Probe of the Dynamic Universe
background_knowledge: 多信使天文学（Multi-Messenger Astronomy）是21世纪天体物理的前沿范式，旨在整合电磁波（从射电到伽马射线）、引力波、中微子及宇宙射线等携带天体事件信息的不同信使，以实现对高能暂现源（如伽马射线暴、快速射电暴、双中子星并合等）的全方位观测。随着下一代大视场、高灵敏度暂现源巡天设施的部署，特别是针对毫秒至小时时标的高能瞬变现象，快速定位（Localisation）与多波段同步观测成为理解极端物理环境下相对论性喷流起源、重元素合成及宇宙学距离测量的关键。
contribution:
- 提出 **GRINTA (Gamma-Ray INternational Transient Array Observatory)** 任务概念，计划于2030年代中期发射，作为小卫星（Small Mission）项目，旨在利用高灵敏度和优秀的角分辨率研究时标从毫秒到小时的暂现源。
- 通过搭载两个互补的载荷，GRINTA 将实现 $5 \text{ keV} - 10 \text{ MeV}$ 能段的全面覆盖，具备**亚角分（sub-arcmin）分辨率**的成像巡天能力。
- 该任务能够检测和定位覆盖约半个天空的伽马射线暴（GRBs），确保与其他多信使观测网络的**快速后续观测（Fast follow-up）**能力无缝对接。
- GRINTA 旨在与2035年后运行的最强大的电磁波、引力波及中微子天文台协同工作，构建新一代多信使观测网络，以探测动态宇宙中的高能瞬变现象。
summary: Recent observations of the transient sky at all wavelengths are increasingly revealing the importance of the multi-messenger and multi-wavelength approach. The GRINTA (Gamma-Ray INternational Transient Array Observatory) mission, proposed for launch around the middle of the next decade, is conceived as a small mission with good sensitivity, excellent angular resolution and fast follow-up capability for studying transient sources at timescales from ms to hours, at the same time ensuring optimal integration with multi-messenger networks. The GRINTA mission will carry two complementary payloads to cover in total the 5 keV-10 MeV band, that will detect and localise gamma-ray bursts covering $\sim$ half of the sky and will be able to perform imaging surveys with sub-arcmin resolution. GRINTA will operate in synergy with the most powerful electromagnetic, gravitational wave and neutrino observatories foreseen to be operational after 2035.

title: Galactic tides in the Solar System within a non-axisymmetric Milky Way model adjusted to Gaia data
background_knowledge: 银河潮汐力（Galactic Tides）是指星系引力场的不均匀性（即梯度）对处于其中的延展天体系统产生的差异作用力。在银河系动力学中，这主要影响奥尔特云（Oort Cloud）中长周期彗星的演化。传统研究通常基于轴对称银河系势场模型及简化的太阳运动轨迹（如假设轨道面稳定），将潮汐力分解为垂直于银盘面和平行于银盘面等方向的简单分量。然而，Gaia 卫星的观测表明银河系具有显著的非轴对称结构（如棒状结构、旋臂结构）。理解这些非轴对称性如何通过完整的潮汐张量影响太阳系动力学，对于重新评估长周期彗星的流入率及奥尔特云的稳定性至关重要。
contribution:
- **建立六参数描述框架**：摒弃了传统的简化轨迹假设与对称性限制，从非轴对称的三维银河势场出发，推导出**六个独立参数** ($G_1$ 至 $G_6$) 以量化银河潮汐力对太阳系的影响。
- **揭示潮汐强度剧烈波动**：利用基于 Gaia 数据的最新银河势场模型与太阳轨迹统计方法，发现即使太阳具有适度的径向与垂直振荡，主导参数 **$G_3$ 沿轨迹变化幅度达一个数量级**，这挑战了银河潮汐力在短时间尺度上相对恒定的传统认知。
- **量化非主导分量与对称性破缺效应**：辅助参数 $G_1$ 和 $G_2$ 可达 $G_3$ 的约 1/2 和 1/4，而 $G_4$ 至 $G_6$ 则约为 $G_3$ 的十分之一。这些非零参数表明潮汐力场存在复杂的几何结构，打破了动力学的积分性。
- **提出动力学演化新后果**：剧烈变化的 $G_3$ 直接调制可观测长周期彗星的通量及“塞德娜天体”（Sednoids）化石区域的范围；各分量的变化及非对称性可能导致奥尔特云结构的长期演化。此外，对于具有大垂直偏移的外星系系统，新参数 $G_4$ 至 $G_6$ 可能起主导作用。
summary:
Context. Galactic tides are external differential forces acting on extended systems immersed in the Galactic potential. They play a key role in the dynamics of comets in the Oort cloud.
  Aims. We aim to establish the strength of Galactic tides from the non-axisymmetric potential of the Milky Way revealed by the Gaia mission, and how this strength evolves along the Galactic trajectory of the Solar System.
  Methods. We derived expressions for Galactic tide parameters independently of any simplified trajectory for a star in the Galaxy or any specific symmetry of the Galactic potential. We obtained six parameters, $G_1$ to $G_6$, that quantify the influence of tides. Using the most up-to-date Galactic potential model, extended here to three dimensions, we studied the time evolution of these parameters along the Sun's trajectory using a statistical approach.
  Results. Even for Galactic trajectories featuring modest radial and vertical excursions, as investigated here, the dominant Galactic parameter, $G_3$, is found to vary by an order of magnitude along the solar trajectory. $G_1$ and $G_2$ reach up to about one half and one quarter, respectively, of $G_3$ along the solar trajectory, whilst parameters $G_4$ to $G_6$ reach up to one tenth of $G_3$.
  Conclusions. Contrary to what is often assumed, all Galactic tide parameters vary widely along the Galactic trajectory of the Solar System. Two consequences can be expected: First, $G_3$ directly affects the flux of observable long-period comets and the extent of the fossilised Sednoids region; second, $G_1$ and $G_2$, and to a lesser extent, $G_4$ to $G_6$, break the integrability of the dynamics, potentially affecting the long-term structure of the Oort cloud. Additionally, the new parameters $G_4$ to $G_6$, while small for the Solar System, may strongly impact extrasolar systems with a large out-of-the-plane excursion in the Galaxy.

title: Calculating the squeezed bispectrum in stochastic inflation by Monte Carlo simulation
contribution:
本文针对量子扩散主导的暴胀模型，在随机 $\boldsymbol{\nabla}$ 形式框架下提出了一种基于蒙特卡洛模拟的计算方法，专门用于求解双相谱在压缩极限下的数值。

- **方法论创新**：该方法是对先前用于计算功率谱的蒙特卡洛方法的扩展。针对原初方法中嵌套路径生成带来的计算成本过高问题，提出了一种**分支生成策略**：仅对暴胀场的演化路径进行**有限次数的分支操作**。这种技巧有效地避免了全路径嵌套模拟，从而极大地降低了计算资源需求，使其能够应用于高维多场模型。
- **模型验证与应用**：通过数值演示验证了该方法的有效性，成功复现了单场和双场混沌暴胀模型中的经典结果。
- **前沿突破**：首次将随机蒙特卡洛方法应用于具有温和瀑布（Mild waterfall）的混合暴胀模型中，计算了其压缩极限下的双相谱。这一工作填补了该特定物理场景下高阶统计量解析计算方法的空白。
summary: The bispectrum of cosmological perturbations is an important probe of inflation and the underlying particle physics. However, calculating it becomes challenging in inflation models where inflaton dynamics is dominated by quantum diffusion rather than slow-roll, especially in the multi-field case. In this paper, employing the stochastic-$δ\mathcal{N}$ formalism, we propose a Monte Carlo-based method to calculate the bispectrum in the squeezed limit, as an extension of the method for the power spectrum that we previously proposed. Our method involves generating paths of inflatons' time evolution that branch only several times, avoiding nested path generation, which incurs a prohibitive computational cost. As numerical demonstrations, we apply the proposed method to single- and double-field chaotic inflation for validation, and to hybrid inflation with mild waterfall, for which, to the best of our knowledge, the bispectrum is calculated for the first time in this work.

title: Lightweight Soft X-ray Imager (LSXI) with glass-based coded mask
background_knowledge:
在硬 X 射线和伽马射线天文中，由于光子能量较高，传统的光学折射透镜或反射镜难以聚焦，因此成像手段主要依赖于**掩膜成像（Mask Imaging）**技术。该技术的核心原理是利用一个具有特定编码图案（如均匀冗余阵列 URA）的掩膜板（Coded Mask）阻挡部分入射光子，从而在探测器上形成莫尔条纹状或伪随机的投影。通过数学去卷积算法，可以从投影数据中重建出天空的源图像。
\n掩膜成像系统通常包含掩膜板、分离间隙（Sagitta）和位置灵敏探测器。为了获得高灵敏度和高空间分辨率，掩膜板需要尽可能靠近探测器，这意味着掩膜板自身必须具有极高的结构刚性和平整度，以承受空间环境下的振动和热变形。然而，传统的掩膜板设计（如厚金属板或复杂的支撑结构）往往导致系统体积庞大、重量高昂，难以适应当前日益流行的微小卫星（如 CubeSat）对**SWaP**（尺寸、重量和功耗）的严格限制。
contribution:
- 提出了一种基于**微通道板（MCP）技术**的玻璃基轻质软 X 射线成像仪（LSXI），利用玻璃的高刚性实现了**轻量化**（总重控制在 **1 kg** 以内）、紧凑且自支撑的编码掩膜设计。
- 通过 X 射线束线实验成功展示了该设计的有效性，验证了其从编码投影中重建图像数据的可行性。
- 利用蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulations）评估了将 LSXI 集成至 **6U CubeSat** 平台上的在轨性能，重点分析了系统的**灵敏度**及**源定位**能力，为小卫星高能天文观测提供了新的硬件解决方案。
summary: The coded mask technique has been widely used in X-ray and Gamma-ray imagers, especially in space astronomy. However, the traditional design of coded mask imagers usually has problems with large size and heavy weight. Here, we propose a novel design for a coded mask imager made of glass based on microchannel plate (MCP) technology, making it lightweight (within 1 kg), compact, and self-supporting, which is very suitable for space exploration satellites. The design is initially demonstrated by reconstructing encoded patterns from measurements at the X-ray beamline. Monte Carlo simulations of the module integrated into a 6U CubeSat are conducted to assess its in-orbit detector performance, including sensitivity and source localization.

title: Inside-out growth and the kiloparsec-scale star formation main sequence for low-surface-brightness disk galaxies in MaNGA
background_knowledge: 低表面亮度星系（LSBGs）通常具有极为弥散的光度分布，其恒星密度远低于银河系等典型盘状星系，这使其成为宇宙中难以观测且演化历史模糊的一类天体。在星系演化研究中，"恒星形成主序"（Star Formation Main Sequence, SFMS）描述了恒星形成率（SFR）与恒星质量（$M_*$）之间的标度关系，被认为是星系持续积累恒星物质的基本模式。"内-外生长"（inside-out growth）则是大质量盘状星系常见的形成机制，指星系核心区域率先形成恒星，随后恒星形成活动逐渐向外迁移至外围盘面，导致比恒星形成率（sSFR）呈现正径向梯度。MaNGA（Mapping Nearby Galaxies at APO）项目通过积分视场光谱技术（IFS），提供了大量近邻星系内部分辨率的恒星形成信息，为研究LSBGs的内部结构及小尺度（kpc级）SFMS规律提供了关键数据。
contribution:
- **内部结构径向分析**：利用 MaNGA 数据对比了 LSBGs 与 HSBGs（高表面亮度星系）内部恒星质量密度（$\mathrm{Σ_{*}}$）、恒星形成率密度（$\mathrm{Σ_{SFR}}$）及比恒星形成率（$\mathrm{Σ_{sSFR}}$）的径向分布，发现 $\mathrm{Σ_{*}}$ 和 $\mathrm{Σ_{SFR}}$ 均呈负梯度，而 $\mathrm{Σ_{sSFR}}$ 呈正梯度。
- **LSBGs 的"内-外"演化特征**：LSBGs 具有比 HSBGs 更平缓的 $\mathrm{Σ_{*}}$ 和 $\mathrm{Σ_{SFR}}$ 梯度以及更陡峭的 $\mathrm{Σ_{sSFR}}$ 梯度。其中 $\mathrm{Σ_{SFR}}$ 的极小斜率（-0.1 至 -0.2）表明其恒星形成活动在全星系范围内分布均匀，其 $\mathrm{Σ_{sSFR}}$ 的正梯度则证实了这类星系同样遵循"**内-外生长**"（inside-out growth）模式。
- **kpc 尺度 SFMS 的普适性**：研究结果显示 LSBGs 与 HSBGs 服从相同的**全局和分辨（resolved）SFMS**，且中心表面亮度（$\mu_{0}$）对主序斜率无明显影响。全局与 kpc 尺度主序斜率的一致性表明，LSBGs 的恒星形成过程在较小尺度上依然受**局部物理过程**调控，符合通用的星系恒星形成标度律。
- **样本定义的影响**：强调在处理不同电离源时，采用仅包含恒星形成区域的 $\mathrm{Σ_{SFR}}$ 和 $\mathrm{Σ_{*}}$ 映射能更准确地描述主序关系，对激发源的不当处理会显著改变主序的拟合斜率。
summary: Low surface brightness galaxies (LSBGs) are very faint objects in the universe whose formation and evolution have long remained an unresolved problem. We selected a late-type, face-on, and disk-dominated galaxy sample from the MaNGA survey, composed of 38 LSBGs and 216 high surface brightness galaxies (HSBGs) by adopting a central surface brightness threshold $μ_{0}(g) = {\rm 22.0\ mag\ arcsec^{-2}}$. Based on maps derived from pipe3D products of star-forming areas in galaxies, we investigated the global and resolved star formation main sequence (SFMS and rSFMS) and radial profiles of the stellar mass density ($\mathrm{Σ_{*}}$), star formation rate density ($\mathrm{Σ_{SFR}}$), and specific star formation rate ($\mathrm{Σ_{sSFR}}$). The radial profiles of $\mathrm{Σ_{*}}$ and $\mathrm{Σ_{SFR}}$ present negative gradients, while those of $\mathrm{Σ_{sSFR}}$ present positive gradients. Compared to HSBGs, the LSBGs show similar, flatter, and steeper slopes in $\mathrm{Σ_{*}}$, $\mathrm{Σ_{SFR}}$, and $\mathrm{Σ_{sSFR}}$ gradients, respectively. The very flat $\mathrm{Σ_{SFR}}$ gradients of LSBGs, whose slopes range from -0.1 to -0.2, indicates uniform star formation throughout the whole galaxy, and the positive $\mathrm{Σ_{sSFR}}$ gradients reflects their ``inside-out'' growth. Our LSBGs and HSBGs follow the same global and resolved SFMS as the full sample, and $μ_{0}$ shows no influence on both SFMS and rSFMS. For our full sample and two subsamples (HSBGs and LSBGs), the slopes of global SFMS and rSFMS are consistent, which indicates that the SFMS still hold on a kiloparsec scale and the star formation activities are regulated by local events. The treatment of different excitation sources in galaxies affects the slope of the SFMS and rSFMS, and using star-forming areas only is more advisable.

title: Double Gravity-Assist Rendezvous Trajectory to Halley's Comet Using Deep-Space Low Thrust
background_knowledge:
该研究属于航天动力学与深空探测任务设计领域。彗星1P/Halley（哈雷彗星）因其长周期、逆行及高倾角轨道，使得传统飞越（Flyby）任务相对速度极高，科学观测时间受限。要实现彗星交会（Rendezvous），需巨大的速度增量（$\Delta v$）来匹配彗星轨道平面与相位，这对推进系统提出严苛挑战。
\n深空低推力推进（如霍尔效应推进器）虽能提供高比冲、节省燃料，但推力小，加速过程漫长，且对轨道约束敏感。引力辅助（Gravity Assist）利用行星运动动量交换，可显著改变探测器速度矢量与轨道平面，降低推进需求。将低推力弧段与行星引力辅助结合，形成“双引力辅助+低推力”混合架构，是当前突破高能量轨道（如彗星交会）任务设计瓶颈的关键范式。
contribution:
- 提出一种 novel 的哈雷彗星2061年近日点交会任务策略，创新性结合木星与土星的双重无动力引力辅助（Double Gravity-Assist）与深空低推力弧段（Deep-Space Low-Thrust Arcs），以克服高倾角逆行轨道带来的巨大能量壁垒。

- 该策略显著优化了任务经济性：通过利用引力辅助分担主要平面改变机动，**大幅降低发射能量与推进剂预算**；同时将抵达时间精确约束在彗星高活动期开始之前，确保最佳科学观测窗口。

- 发展了一套高效的轨迹设计方法论：给出最优飞越几何形状的闭合解析表达式，并采用显式低推力转录技术，将设计参数压缩至三个，**极大提升了计算效率与设计空间探索能力**。

- 验证了工程可行性：这是首个仅依赖成熟技术（标准放射性同位素热电发生器RTG与霍尔效应推进器）且兼容现有主流运载火箭的哈雷彗星交会概念，展示了在给定约束下两条有前景的原理验证轨迹。
summary: The perihelion of comet 1P/Halley in 2061 is an excellent chance to revisit this object of outstanding scientific and cultural relevance. During its 1986 approach to the Sun, it was targeted by several flyby missions. Due to its retrograde, highly-inclined orbit, the relative velocities during the encounter were large, limiting the scientific return due to the short time spent inside the coma. A rendezvous trajectory would overcome this limitation, but the design is challenging due to the limitations of current propulsion technology. Given the lead times of spacecraft development and the long duration of the interplanetary transfer to the comet, it is imperative to start mission planning as soon as possible. We present a novel rendezvous strategy, combining unpowered Jupiter and Saturn gravity-assists with deep-space low-thrust arcs. It minimizes launch energy and propellant budget, constraining the arrival to occur before the onset of high activity. The double flyby strategy reduces the otherwise prohibitive cost of the plane change maneuver. Closed expressions for the optimal flyby geometry, together with an explicit low-thrust transcription technique, reduce the number of design parameter to three, improving computational efficiency. Crucially, this is the first rendezvous mission concept achievable with well-proven technology (standard radioisotope thermoelectric generators and a Hall-effect thruster) and compatible with several existing launchers. We describe the trajectory optimization strategy and perform a comprehensive exploration of the design space. Finally, we present two promising proof-of-concept trajectories in detail.

title: Blast.jl: Differentiable Non-Limber Power Spectra for Joint Clustering, Shear, and CMB lensing Analyses
background_knowledge: 在大尺度结构（LSS）研究中，角功率谱 $C_l$ 是描述星系分布、弱引力透镜剪切以及宇宙微波背景（CMB）透镜效应等观测量的核心统计量。为了从三维宇宙密度场预测二维天球上的角功率谱，传统理论计算常采用 Limber 近似。该近似假设观测波数 $k$ 极大，从而简化了投影积分，在小角尺度（高 $l$ 模态）下极其高效且准确。然而，在**大角尺度（低 $l$ 模态，即 $l \lesssim 10$）**，Limber 近似会引入不可忽略的偏差，此时必须使用完整的非 Limber 投影计算。此外，随着观测精度的提升（如 Euclid, LSST, Roman 等任务），大尺度上的**相对论效应**（如 ISW、磁化率偏差、RSD）变得至关重要。同时，现代宇宙学推断越来越依赖于梯度优化算法（如 Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, MCMC 变体），这要求理论预测模型必须是**可微分（Differentiable）**的，以便高效计算似然函数对宇宙学参数的梯度。
contribution:
- **算法扩展与物理完备性**：基于 Chebyshev 多项式分解框架，大幅扩展了 `Blast.jl` 数值工具包，使其能够高效计算**非 Limber** 角功率谱。新算法纳入了多种关键的物理与观测效应，包括红移空间畸变（RSD）、磁化率偏差、原初非高斯性（PNG）、星系固有排列（IA）、CMB 透镜效应以及 ISW 效应。
- **可微分性与计算效率**：通过引入自定义自动微分规则，确保了所有计算流程在保持完全可微分的同时，实现了高效的计算缩放（Scaling）。通过预先计算与宇宙学参数无关的量，有效平衡了计算速度与精度。
- **验证与应用演示**：通过与暴力积分及主流宇宙学代码（如 CAMB/CosmoPower 等）对比，严格验证了算法的准确性。进一步利用 LSST Y10 模拟数据演示了该工具在梯度推断中的实际应用，成功从一个包含 35 个参数的模型中恢复出无偏的宇宙学及系统误差参数，证明了其在大规模联合分析（Clustering + Shear + CMB Lensing）中的就绪状态。
summary: Upcoming large-scale structure surveys require accurate theoretical predictions for angular power spectra on the largest angular scales, where the commonly used Limber approximation breaks down and multiple relativistic and observational effects become relevant. At the same time, modern cosmological analyses increasingly rely on gradient-based inference techniques, motivating the development of fast, fully differentiable algorithms. In this work, we present a major extension of Blast.jl, a numerical toolkit for the efficient computation of non-Limber angular power spectra. Building on the Chebyshev-polynomial decomposition of the original framework, the updated algorithm incorporates redshift-space distortions, magnification bias, primordial non-Gaussianity, intrinsic alignments, CMB lensing, and the integrated Sachs-Wolfe effect, while remaining fully differentiable through custom automatic differentiation rules. Despite the increased physical complexity, the algorithm retains favorable scaling by precomputing all cosmology-independent quantities. We validate the expanded framework against brute-force integration and established cosmological codes, and provide a detailed analysis of the trade-off between computational speed and precision as a function of the algorithm hyperparameters. We demonstrate the readiness of Blast.jl for gradient-based inference through a simulated likelihood analysis with LSST Y10-like mock data, recovering unbiased cosmological and nuisance parameter constraints from a 35-parameter model using gradient-based samplers.

title: IFU Observations of Comet 3I/ATLAS = C/2025 N1 (ATLAS) using the Hobby-Eberly Telescope with the VIRUS Instrument
background_knowledge: 星际天体（Interstellar Objects, ISOs）是指起源于太阳系之外，以双曲线轨道穿越太阳系的天体。它们是研究银河系内其他恒星系统行星形成过程、化学成分多样性以及天体演化历史的重要样本。继 'Oumuamua (1I) 和 Borisov (2I) 之后，对这类天体的观测主要依赖于光谱学手段，特别是通过测量挥发性物质（如 H_2O, CO, CN, C_2 等分子以及 Na, Fe, Ni 等原子）的发射线来推断其表面组成和活动性。传统的彗星光谱分析通常基于 Haser 模型，该模型假设气体以恒定速度从彗核径向流出，其空间分布由光致电离和光解离的寿命（即尺度长度）决定。通过积分场光谱（IFS/IFU）技术，可以同时获得天体的空间分布和光谱信息，从而更精细地解析彗发（coma）的结构和动力学特性。
contribution:
- 利用 Hobby-Eberly 望远镜（HET）搭载的 VIRUS 积分场光谱仪，对星际天体 3I/ATLAS (C/2025 N1) 进行了高分辨率空间的光谱观测。观测于 2025 年 12 月 9 日进行，地心距离为 $1.83$ au。
- 实现了从彗星光学中心向外至约 $85,000$ km 太阳方向的空间光谱采样，采样间隔仅为 $1$ arcsec（对应约 $1327$ km），展现了 VIRUS 在近距离天体观测中的卓越空间分辨率优势。
- **光谱特征发现**：在探测到典型太阳系彗星常见的分子发射特征外，观测到**极强的中性铁（Fe I）和中性镍（Ni I）原子发射线**，这暗示了 3I/ATLAS 可能具有不同于普通太阳系彗星的表面化学组成或尘埃-气体比率。
- **动力学模型分析**：基于 Haser (1957) 模型框架拟合光谱数据，发现**只有假设其气体流出速度为相同日心距离下太阳系彗星流出速度的一半时，模型才能成功拟合数据**。
- 推导了针对三条 Ni I 和四条 Fe I 发射线的 Haser 模型尺度长度，并讨论了这些异常结果对于理解星际彗星与本地太阳系彗星在物理机制和化学演化上异同点的科学意义。
summary: We observed interstellar object 3I/ATLAS = C/2025 N1 (ATLAS) on 9 December 2025 UT with the VIRUS spectrograph on the Hobby-Eberly Telescope. VIRUS is a low spectral resolving power, multi-IFU, optical spectrograph. We used a single IFU for the observations and were able to obtain spectra spaced every one arcsec (1327 km) from the optocenter out to about 85,000 km in the sunward direction. The spectra include molecular features normally seen in the optical for spectra of Solar System comets, with the addition of many very strong lines of FeI and NiI. We modeled these observations using the Haser (1957) model framework and find that the data can only be fit if we assume that the outflow velocity of the gas is half that of comets in our Solar System observed at the same heliocentric distance. We derived Haser model scale lengths for three NiI and four FeI lines. We discuss the implication of the similarities and differences between this object and normal Solar System comets. The excellent spatial resolution of VIRUS, coupled with a FOV of 50X50 arcsecs and a geocentric distance of 1.83 au, allowed us to probe the coma of 3I in great detail.

title: Tremaine-Gunn Control: Evading Bounds on Light Fermion Dark Matter
background_knowledge: 在暗物质物理中，**Tremaine-Gunn (TG) 界限**是一个基于量子统计力学（泡利不相容原理）的经典约束。该理论指出，若暗物质由费米子构成，其相空间密度存在上限 $f_{max} \propto m_{\chi}^4$。由于观测到的矮星系（dwarf galaxies）具有极高的相空间密度，这通常要求费米子暗物质的质量下限在 keV 量级（即“温暗物质”WDM）。若费米子质量过轻（如 eV 量级），其简并压力会导致暗物质晕无法在如此小的尺度上坍缩至观测到的密度，除非引入非标准模型相互作用。传统的冷暗物质（CDM）或温暗物质范式通常假设暗物质仅通过引力或极弱的相互作用聚集。然而，**暗扇区相互作用（Dark Sector Interactions）**的引入可能改变这一图景，允许在特定尺度上形成自束缚结构（Self-bound objects），从而在保持微观粒子质量极低的同时，宏观上模拟出致密天体的动力学特征。
contribution:
- 论文指出，传统的 Tremaine-Gunn 界限依赖于“自由费米气体”假设，而**暗扇区内的强相互作用可以显著削弱这一结论**，使得极轻的费米子暗物质成为可能。
- 研究发现，**eV 量级的费米子暗物质**可以通过一种新的机制形成具有矮星系特征尺寸和密度的束缚结构，从而规避常规的 TG 质量下限约束。
- 在这类新形成的致密暗物质结构中，**量子简并压力被一种吸引性的、有限范围的标量 Yukawa 力所平衡**。该相互作用力在短程（矮星系尺度）上远强于引力，但在大尺度上被屏蔽（screened），确保了其不干扰宇宙大尺度结构的引力形成过程。
- 论文推导了这种暗物质流体的演化方程，并证明存在一个可行的宇宙学历史：**结构首先通过引力形成，而新的非引力相互作用仅在晚期（late times）激活**，从而满足结构形成约束。
- 作为概念验证（proof of concept），作者构建了一个模型，其中**单一的晚期相变（late-time phase transition）**即可产生所需的动力学，确立了极轻费米子暗物质的新途径，并证明了暗扇区相互作用能**定性改变常规的相空间限制**。
summary: Pauli exclusion is often regarded as imposing a model-independent lower bound on the mass of fermionic dark matter in galaxies. We show that dark-sector interactions can substantially weaken this conclusion. In particular, eV-scale fermions can form bound structures with the characteristic sizes and densities of dwarf galaxies, thereby circumventing the conventional Tremaine-Gunn mass constraint. Within these objects, the degeneracy pressure is balanced by an attractive finite-range scalar Yukawa force that is significantly stronger than gravity. The interaction acts on dwarf-galaxy scales while remaining screened on larger scales. We derive the evolution of the resulting dark-matter fluid and identify a viable cosmological history in which structures first form gravitationally, with the new interaction becoming active only at late times. As a proof of concept, we construct a model in which a single late-time phase transition generates the required dynamics. These results provide a new route to exceptionally light fermionic dark matter and demonstrate that dark-sector interactions can qualitatively alter conventional phase-space limits.

title: Primordial Black Hole Assisted Dirac Leptogenesis
background_knowledge: 重子不对称性（Baryon Asymmetry of the Universe, BAU）是粒子物理与宇宙学的核心问题之一，要求早期宇宙中存在满足 Sakharov 条件（C/CP 破坏、重子数破坏、偏离热平衡）的动力学机制。传统的轻子生成（Leptogenesis）通常基于 Majorana 中微子，其中总轻子数不守恒。相比之下，**狄拉克轻子生成（Dirac Leptogenesis）** 保留了总轻子数守恒，但通过电弱球面（sphaleron）过程，将初始产生的不对称性部分存储在不可见的右手中微子扇区，部分转化为可见物质扇区的重子不对称性。原初黑洞（Primordial Black Holes, PBHs）作为早期宇宙高密度涨落的产物，其霍金辐射与蒸发过程引入了非热平衡的粒子产生、熵注入以及修正哈勃膨胀率，成为研究重子不对称性生成机制的重要新窗口。
contribution:
- 本研究首次在最小带电荷标量中介子模型框架下，系统解决了耦合的玻尔兹曼方程组，全面纳入中介子 $X$ 的热产生、PBH 霍金辐射对 $X$ 与右手中微子的产生、PBH 主导的膨胀率修正及熵注入效应。
- **PBH 显著拓展了狄拉克轻子生成的有效参数空间**：在中介子质量 $m_X \sim 10^9\,{\rm GeV}$ 且热产生效率低下的区域，霍金辐射能有效填充 $X$ 丰度，通过后续 CP 破坏衰变增强重子不对称性，并将成功生成区域下延至 $m_X \sim 10^6\,{\rm GeV}$，同时补偿较小的有效 CP 不对称度。
- 揭示该增强效应的**非普适性**：当热狄拉克轻子生成本身已足够高效时，PBH 蒸发引发的熵稀释反而可能削弱最终的重子不对称性。
- 计算了 PBH 蒸发在右手中微子扇区沉积的能量贡献，发现在成功重现观测 BAU 的参数扫描区域中，有效相对论性中微子物种数增量 $\Delta N_{\rm eff}$ 介于当前 Planck 参考上限 $0.284$ 与未来 CMB-S4 预期灵敏度 $0.06$ 之间，从而为结合宇宙微波背景（CMB）观测与轻子生成理论提供了可检验的联合探针。
summary: Dirac leptogenesis offers a qualitatively different route to the baryon asymmetry: total lepton number is conserved, but equal and opposite asymmetries are stored in the Standard Model and right handed neutrino sectors, with only the visible component processed by electroweak sphalerons. We present the first dedicated study of how evaporating primordial black holes (PBHs) modify this mechanism. In a minimal charged-scalar mediator setup, we solve the coupled Boltzmann system including thermal production, Hawking emission of the mediator $X$ and of right handed neutrinos, the PBH contribution to the expansion rate, and entropy injection. We find that Hawking emission can populate $X$ in regions where thermal production is inefficient, allowing its subsequent CP-violating decays to enhance the baryon asymmetry. For representative benchmarks, PBHs extend the successful region from mediator masses around $10^9\,{\rm GeV}$ down to about $10^6\,{\rm GeV}$ and can compensate for smaller effective CP asymmetries. This effect is not universal: where thermal Dirac leptogenesis is already efficient, PBHs can instead reduce the final asymmetry. Their evaporation also deposits energy in the right handed neutrino sector and contributes to $ΔN_{\rm eff}$. In the PBH parameter scan, part of the region that reproduces the observed baryon asymmetry lies below the Planck reference level $ΔN_{\rm eff}=0.284$ and above the projected CMB-S4 sensitivity $ΔN_{\rm eff}=0.06$.

title: Axion Quality from Exact Proton Stability
background_knowledge: Axion Quality 是轴子模型（尤其是 QCD 轴子）在宇宙学和粒子物理研究中面临的一个核心概念难题。在传统的 Peccei-Quinn (PQ) 机制中，PQ 对称性被引入以自然解决强相互作用中的 CP 问题（即为什么强相互作用不违反 CP 对称性），但这一机制本身是“人为的”。如果存在量子引力效应或某些未知的高维算符，它们会显式破坏 PQ 对称性，导致轴子获得非预期的质量，从而无法有效解决强 CP 问题（因为 $\bar{\theta}$ 不再被动力学松弛至零）。因此，我们需要一个“高质量”的轴子，即 PQ 对称性足够精确，使得破坏它的算符维度极高。与此同时，重子数守恒（或质子稳定）与轻子数守恒在许多规范对称性扩展中是紧密相关的。该背景研究的核心范式在于：通过引入精确的离散或连续规范对称性，同时约束高维算符，以实现对 QCD 轴子质量和宇宙学演化（如宇宙弦网络）的严格筛选。
contribution:
- **提出了一种全新的基于对称性的统一框架**：利用一个在红外能标下精确保持、无反常的离散规范对称性 $\boldsymbol{\mathbb{Z}_9}$ 来**绝对禁止质子衰变**。该对称性源于一个味非普适的连续规范群 $\boldsymbol{U(1)_X}$，并能够自然地导出 realistic 的**中微子质量与混合**（通过 high-scale seesaw 机制）。
- **自然导出 QCD 轴子**：通过添加一个无反常的手征重夸克扇区（chiral heavy-quark sector），将 $U(1)_X$ 破缺产生的 Goldstone 玻色子转化为**QCD 轴子**，从而同时解决强 CP 问题。
- **实现高质量的 PQ 对称性（Axion Quality）**：禁止质子衰变的同一套选择定则（selection rules），也**严禁 PQ 对称性破坏算符**的低维出现，要求算符维度达到 $d_{\rm PQ} \gtrsim 10$。这种机制有效抑制了由量子引力效应产生的显式对称性破坏，从而保证了轴子的“高质量”。
- **模型构建与宇宙学演化约束**：构造了显式的理论模型，涵盖 PQ 对称性破缺发生在宇宙暴胀**之前或之后**的两种情形。针对后者（破缺在暴胀后发生），为了消除拓扑缺陷（如宇宙弦-墙网络）并避免产生不稳定的重遗迹（stable heavy relics），论文对**重夸克谱的质量与分布施加了严格约束**。
- **与宇宙暗物质的兼容性**：确定了有限维的参数空间，使得模型在实现**热轻子生成机制**（thermal leptogenesis）的同时，在 PQ 破坏算符维度 $d_{\rm PQ} \geq 13$ 的条件下，允许该高质量轴子**构成全部的暗物质**（constitute all of the dark matter）。
summary: A discrete, anomaly-free $\mathbb Z_9$ gauge symmetry may persist to the deep infrared, exactly forbidding proton decay. This $\mathbb Z_9$ can emerge from Higgsing a lepton-flavour non-universal $U(1)_X$ that generates realistic neutrino masses and mixings through a high-scale seesaw and predicts an additional light Goldstone. Adding an anomaly-free chiral heavy-quark sector turns this mode into the QCD axion. The same selection rules that ban proton decay also forbid PQ-violating operators below a suitably high dimension, $d_{\rm PQ}\gtrsim10$, including operators involving the heavy quarks that radiatively match onto the scalar potential. We construct explicit models viable when PQ breaking occurs before or after inflation; in the latter case, avoiding stable heavy relics and eliminating the string-wall network tightly constrain the heavy-quark spectrum. We identify restricted regions of parameter space where thermal leptogenesis remains viable and, for $d_{\rm PQ}\geq13$, can coexist with a high-quality axion constituting all of the dark matter.

title: Strong Constraints on Higgsino Dark Matter from Solar Capture
background_knowledge:
Higgsino 是超对称模型（SUSY）中电弱真空稳定性（Little Hierarchy Problem）自然预测出的暗物质候选者。在纯 Higgsino 情形下，中性微子（neutralino）中的 Higgsino 分量形成简并的 Majorana 粒子对。然而，由于弱相互作用的辐射修正，这对 Majorana 粒子的质量会发生微小的分裂（mass splitting, $\delta$），使得它们表现为“准狄拉克”（quasi-Dirac）费米子，通常包含一个极轻的微子（mass splitting 仅为 MeV 量级或更低）。

**太阳引力俘获机制**是限制此类暗物质的重要探针。当暗物质粒子进入太阳系并穿过太阳核心时，受太阳强大引力势的影响，它们会加速至约 $1400\,\mathrm{km/s}$。在该高能状态下，Higgsino 与太阳核中的重元素发生非弹性散射（inelastic scattering）的截面显著增强。这种散射会消耗暗物质的动能，使其落入束缚轨道并被长期俘获。随着时间推移，被俘获的暗物质达到产生-俘获平衡，并通过自湮灭过程（如 $\chi\chi \to W^+W^-, ZZ$）产生高能粒子，最终表现为可探测的高能中微子辐射。因此，地下中微子望远镜（如 IceCube）对太阳方向高能中微子的观测结果，可以强有力地限制被俘获并湮灭的暗物质粒子的质量与参数空间。
contribution:
- 本研究针对**准狄拉克 Higgsino 暗物质**模型，在保持宇宙学偏好质量 $m_\chi \simeq 1.08\,\mathrm{TeV}$ 的情况下，将 Majorana 成分间的质量分裂 $\delta$ 作为自由参数进行了详细分析。
- 论文利用**太阳引力加速效应**（核心处速度高达 $\sim 1400\,\mathrm{km/s}$），量化了 Higgsino 在太阳核心通过非弹性散射于重元素发生的有效俘获率。
- 针对 $\chi\chi\to W^+W^-,ZZ$ 湮灭通道产生的预期中微子通量，并与 **IceCube 中微子观测台**的高能中微子非探测结果进行对照。
- **核心科学发现**：
  - 确立了关于质量分裂的稳健下限：$\delta > 566\,\mathrm{keV}$。这意味着若 $\delta$ 低于此值，理论预测的中微子通量将超出 IceCube 的观测限制。
  - 该限制条件**彻底排除了近期 LZ 探测器异常事件源于吸热（endothermic）非弹性散射**的理论解释，因为 LZ 信号通常暗示极小的质量分裂（$\delta \sim$ few keV），而 $\delta > 566\,\mathrm{keV}$ 的限制使得在当前的 LZ 散射截面上无法解释该信号。
summary: Higgsino dark matter remains one of the most convincing dark matter candidates. It can exist in a ``quasi-Dirac" regime, when the splitting between two Majorana components is on the order of $O(\rm few~\,MeV)$ or less. Owing to the strong gravitational pull of the Sun, the DM particles accelerate to up to $\sim 1400$\,km/sec in the solar core, which allows for inelastic scattering on heavy elements and very effective capture onto solar-bound trajectories. We evaluate the expected flux of the neutrinos from the expected $χχ\to W^+W^-,ZZ$ annihilation for the cosmologically preferred mass, $m_χ\simeq 1.08$\,TeV while keeping the mass splitting $δ$ as a free parameter. Confronting it with the non-observation of high-energy neutrinos from the Sun by the IceCube experiment, we obtain a robust limit, $δ>566$\,keV. These limits exclude the interpretation of the recent LZ event in terms of endothermic inelastic scattering of Higgsino dark matter on xenon nuclei.

title: The Neutral Atomic Hydrogen in the solar neighborhood (NeAtHood) project I. Ghost in the shell: Neutral atomic hydrogen in the extended Orion nebula
background_knowledge: 在银河系及近邻宇宙（Local Universe）中，大质量恒星形成区（如猎户座星云）是研究恒星反馈机制的关键实验室。大质量恒星的强辐射场和高速恒星风会向周围星际介质（ISM）注入大量的质量、能量和动量，从而塑造出复杂的**多相结构**。这些结构通常包括电离气体区（HII区）、光致电离边缘（PDRs，常通过 [CII] 发射线示踪）以及受扰动形成的原子氢（HI）壳层或气泡。由于星际介质中不同相态的气体在密度、温度和化学组成上差异巨大，仅凭单一示踪物（如电离气体或分子气体）往往难以重构完整的质量分布和动力学历史。21厘米中性原子氢谱线观测是描绘受恒星风吹拂形成的扩展气泡结构的重要工具，能够揭示电离区之外的中性气体动力学特征。
contribution:
- **首次解析扩展猎户座星云（EON）的HI壳层结构**：利用空间分辨率达 $1'$（对应物理尺度 $
0.12 \text{ pc}$）的 21 厘米中性原子氢（HI）发射线观测，首次分辨了 EON 中的 HI 气体，揭示了一个**正在膨胀的壳层**，其轮廓与近期观测到的电离碳 [CII] 发射线划定的区域相吻合。
- **修正大质量恒星风气泡的质量估算**：结合单天线望远镜和干涉阵的 HI 观测数据，估算出壳层前半球的质量约为 $100 M_\odot$。这一结果**比基于 [CII] 发射线推断的质量低约一个数量级**（约10倍），表明此前文献中对该最近恒星风气泡的质量存在**高估**现象；尽管不能排除部分质量可能以分子氢（$\text{H}_2$）形式隐藏在壳层中。
- **发现未知的周边结构**：扩展的 21 厘米线图谱还揭示了 EON 内部及周边的未探测结构，包括一个**可能的次级气泡**和一个从壳层边界延伸出约 $4 \text{ pc}$ 的**线性突出物**。
- **展示HI干涉观测在解析多相星际介质中的潜力**：证明了HI干涉仪观测在阐明恒星形成区多相结构及其与周围介质相互作用方面的关键作用，为理解大质量恒星反馈的物理图像提供了新的视角。
summary: The Orion Nebula is the nearest site of ongoing and recent high-mass star formation. It is a unique laboratory for studying the mass, energy, and momentum input from high-mass stars. We present 21-centimeter emission line observations that resolve for the first time the neutral atomic hydrogen (HI) gas in the extended Orion nebula (EON) at a resolution of one arcminute, which corresponds to a physical scale of 0.12 parsecs at the standard distance to the region. Our HI emission maps reveal an expanding shell that matches the EON contours delineated by recent observations of ionized carbon ([CII]) line emission. However, our combination of single-dish and interferometric HI observations suggests 100 solar masses of material for the front hemisphere of the shell, which is lower by roughly a factor of ten than the mass inferred from [CII] observations. This discrepancy suggests that the mass of the nearest wind-blown bubble has been overestimated, although we do not rule out the possibility that a significant amount of molecular hydrogen (H_2) in the shell may account for part of the difference. Our extended 21 cm line maps also reveal uncharted structures in and around the EON. They include a probable secondary bubble and a linear protrusion extending roughly four parsecs from the shell boundary. Our results illustrate the potential of HI interferometric observations to elucidate key aspects of the multiphase structure of star-forming regions and their connection to their surroundings.

title: A measurement-based approach to EPFD calculation, to quantify the impact of satellite mega-constellations on low-frequency radio astronomy
background_knowledge:
低频射电天文学（Low-frequency Radio Astronomy, LFRA）是探索宇宙黎明、中性氢分布及银河系物理的重要窗口，通常工作在 $\lesssim 100$ MHz 频段。然而，随着近地轨道（LEO）卫星巨型星座的部署，人造电磁辐射（包括无意产生的电磁辐射，UEMR）已成为该领域的主要干扰源。
\n在频谱管理与兼容性分析中，**等效功率通量密度（Equivalent Power Flux-Density, EPFD）** 是一个核心的工程指标。传统的 EPFD 评估主要基于“前向模型”（Forward-model）方法：即利用卫星轨道、发射参数及天线方向图进行理论计算和仿真，预测接收机处的干扰电平。国际电信联盟（ITU-R）制定了 RA.769-2（保护射电天文业务的干扰阈值）和 RA.1513-2（兼容性判据，通常要求干扰导致的数据损失率低于 2%）等标准。
\n然而，前向模型存在局限性，特别是在复杂系统或难以精确建模的非连续波干扰（CW/NB）场景中。对于低频射电望远镜（通常具有大视场、干涉阵特性且环境反射复杂），传统的点源模型可能无法准确反映实际的天空亮度变化。因此，从“理论预测”转向基于实际望远镜数据的“测量驱动”方法，对于量化卫星对实际观测的真实影响及推动法规执行至关重要。
contribution:
- **方法创新与EPFD适配**：本研究首次提出并验证了一种**基于测量数据**的 EPFD 计算途径。通过对全天空干涉成像数据的应用，成功解决了前向模型计算与实际低频宽视场干涉仪测量在概念上的差异，实现了将 ITU-R EPFD 框架直接应用于实测数据。

- **干扰阈值突破确认**：测量结果显示，当前卫星巨型星座产生的 UEMR 导致的 EPFD 分布**超过 ITU-R RA.769-2 规定的射电天文干扰阈值的样本比例高达 50-70%**。这一发现从实测角度确认了之前（Di Vruno et al. 2023）的理论估算结果。

- **兼容性评估与衰减需求**：实测数据远超 ITU-R RA.1513-2 中规定的 **2% 单系统数据损失判据**。以传统兼容性余量（margin）表示，计算出的数值为负，范围在 **-18.6 dB 至 -16.3 dB** 之间。这量化地表明，为了达到可接受的观测环境，必须对干扰信号实施 **16.3 - 18.6 dB 的一致衰减**。

- **监管与监测范式**：该工作证明了测量驱动方法在低频射电天文中具有实际可行性，为干扰验证和长期监测提供了一种实用路径，这可能成为未来法规执行（enforceability）的重要技术组件。
summary: Context: Satellite mega-constellations generate Unintended Electro-Magnetic Radiation (UEMR) impacting low frequency radio astronomy. The Radio Regulations of the International Telecommunications Union Radiocommunication Sector (ITU-R) contain the basis for addressing UEMR, but enforcement mechanisms are absent. Aims: To adapt compatibility study methods based on satellite constellation simulations, in particular the Equivalent Power Flux-Density (EPFD) framework, to radio telescope measurements. Methods: We adapt the ITU-R EPFD calculation framework to measurement data obtained from all-sky interferometric imaging. We address the conceptual differences between forward-model EPFD calculations and measurement-based approaches. In particular, we consider low frequency systems, which are typically wide field-of-view and interferometric instruments. Results: For the first time, we demonstrate that all-sky interferometric observations enable a direct adaptation of the EPFD formalism to measurement data. We thus confirm previous estimations (Di Vruno et al. 2023) that the resulting measurement-based EPFD distributions exceed the radio astronomy interference threshold levels defined in Recommendation ITU-R RA.769-2 in 50-70% of samples. These exceedance fractions are well above the 2% single-system data-loss criterion in Recommendation ITU-R RA.1513-2. Expressed using the conventional 2% compatibility margin, the corresponding margins are negative, ranging from -18.6 to -16.3 dB, equivalent to a required uniform attenuation of 16.3-18.6 dB. Conclusions: Measurement-based implementations provide a practical pathway toward verification and long-term monitoring at low radio frequencies, which could form an important component of enforceability. We suggest instrumentation approaches to support measurement.

title: Scientific performances of the XGIS instrument on-board THESEUS
background_knowledge: 伽马射线暴（GRBs）是宇宙中最剧烈的高能暂现源，起源于大质量恒星核心坍缩或致密天体并合，其余辉可跨越从射电到 TeV 能段的整个电磁波谱。GRBs 因其极高的亮度，可作为探测宇宙早期（如宇宙再电离时期）极端物理环境和星系演化历史的“信使”。然而，准确测量高红移 GRBs 的光度、红移及宇宙学参数，依赖于仪器在宽视场（Wide Field of View, FoV）、高时间分辨率（Timing）和宽能段（从软 X 射线至 MeV）下的联合成像与光谱能力。coded mask（编码掩模）成像技术是实现大视场高能天体精确定位的主流手段，它通过掩模图案对入射光子进行调制，并结合反卷积算法恢复源的空间信息。目前，主流卫星如 Swift 和 Fermi 在视场覆盖和高能响应上仍有局限，这促使了下一代高能天文台（如 THESEUS）的设计与研制。
contribution:
本文详细介绍了 THESEUS 卫星核心有效载荷 XGIS（X 和 Gamma Imaging Spectrometer）仪器的科学性能，重点评估了其灵敏度与源定位精度。主要发现包括：

- **宽视场与高能响应设计**：XGIS 旨在通过两台基于编码掩模成像技术的相同相机，实现 **$> 2$ steradians** 的宽视场成像，其视场部分重叠，可覆盖近一半天空。该设计确保在 **$2-150$ keV** 能段获得精确天空图像，同时具备良好计时和光谱能力，延伸至 **数 MeV**。

- **高红移 GRB 探测仿真**：通过详细的蒙特卡罗模拟，结合 XGIS 成像系统的设计参数与高红移 GRB 群体属性，论文量化了 XGIS 在发现与精确测量高红移伽马射线暴方面的预期科学进步。

- **科学性能优势**：XGIS 的视场与能段覆盖能力将显著提升对暂现源（特别是 GRBs）的发现率与定位精度，为利用 GRBs 进行宇宙学探针研究提供关键的观测数据支撑。
summary: The Transient High Energy Sky and Early Universe Surveyor (THESEUS) satellite, currently undergoing a Phase-A study for the M7 ESA mission selection, will mainly rely on the XGIS (X and Gamma Imaging Spectrometer) instrument to discover and precisely localise gamma-ray bursts and other high-energy transients. The XGIS instrument has been designed to provide accurate sky images in a wide field of view (>2 steradians) in the 2-150 keV band, coupled to coverage of nearly half of the sky with good timing and spectroscopic capabilities up to several MeV. This will be achieved thanks to the combination of two identical cameras, based on the coded mask imaging technique, oriented to provide partially overlapping fields of view. We present the capabilities of the XGIS, focussing in particular on the sensitivity and source location accuracy. We discuss the expected scientific advances in the GRB field, estimated through detailed Monte-Carlo simulations which take into account the design of the XGIS imaging system and the properties of the GRB population at high redshifts.

title: Disc-Based Estimation of the Local Dark Matter Density and Velocity Distribution in IllustrisTNG50
background_knowledge: 在直接探测暗物质（Dark Matter, DM）的理论框架中，银河系晕内的暗物质分布模型至关重要，其中**标准晕模型（Standard Halo Model, SHM）**假设暗物质密度分布遵循NFW或等温球模型，且速度分布为麦克斯韦-玻尔兹曼分布。太阳邻域（Solar Neighborhood）的暗物质参数，如局部密度 $\rho_0$ 和速度弥散 $\sigma_v$，直接决定了暗物质与探测器原子核的散射率上限。传统的观测推断（如质量建模）和纯数值模拟（基于球对称半径截断）往往难以精确区分盘状结构与晕状结构。由于银河系是一个具有显著盘状结构的星系，提取“盘关联”的暗物质分布对于更真实地反映太阳邻域环境、评估不同提取方法对直接探测实验限制的影响具有重要的物理意义。
contribution:
- 基于 **IllustrisTNG50** 模拟中的 TNG50-1 运行数据，选取具有类银河系性质（特定晕质量和盘/总恒星质量比）的星系，通过恒星位置与数密度识别太阳邻域，实现了**基于盘的暗物质粒子提取（Disc-based extraction）**，有效抑制了纯晕成分的贡献。
- 获得太阳邻域平均局部暗物质密度 $\rho \simeq 0.47 \pm 0.02~{\rm GeV\,cm^{-3}}$，与当前观测推断范围一致。其中，**盘关联的峰值密度** ($0.41 \pm 0.02~{\rm GeV\,cm^{-3}}$) 明显高于传统简单距离截断提取的结果 ($0.34 \pm 0.02~{\rm GeV\,cm^{-3}}$)，表明前者排除了部分低密度晕成分，但密度分布的宽度变化不大。
- 发现太阳邻域暗物质速度分布可良好地由**各向同性麦克斯韦分布**描述，其最概然速度约为 $226~{\rm km~s^{-1}}$，非常接近标准晕模型（SHM）的设定值。
- 定量对比表明，**基于盘的提取方法与基于距离的简单提取方法**在密度和速度分布上的差异，尚不足以显著影响对现有或未来**直接探测实验结果**的解释。
summary: We study the dark matter (DM) density and velocity distribution in the solar neighborhood of Milky Way-like galaxies using the TNG50-1 run of the IllustrisTNG simulation suite. Milky Way-like galaxies are selected according to both their halo mass and their bulge-to-total stellar mass ratio, and the solar-neighborhood region within each galaxy is identified from the positions and number density of stars, so that DM particles associated with the galactic disc are extracted while contributions from the halo component are suppressed. Averaging over the selected galaxies, we obtain a local DM density of $ρ\simeq 0.47\pm0.02~{\rm GeV\,cm^{-3}}$, consistent with the range inferred from observations. The disc-based extraction gives a higher peak density, $0.41\pm0.02~{\rm GeV\,cm^{-3}}$, than the value $0.34\pm0.02~{\rm GeV\,cm^{-3}}$ from a simple distance-based extraction, probably because it excludes the low-density DM in the halo. The width of the density distribution, on the other hand, is nearly unchanged. The velocity distribution is well described by an isotropic Maxwellian with a peak velocity of about $226~{\rm km~s^{-1}}$, close to the value assumed in the standard halo model. The differences in the density and velocity distributions between our disc-based and simple distance-based extractions are not so large as to significantly affect the interpretation of direct-detection experiments.

title: The Intermediate-Mass Black Hole Reverberation Mapping Project: Scientific Overview and Sample Characteristics
background_knowledge:
在活跃星系核（AGN）研究中，黑洞与其宿主星系的共演化是核心科学问题之一。观测证据显示，星系核球的性质与超大质量黑洞（SMBHs, $M_{\rm BH} \gtrsim 10^6 M_\odot$）之间存在着紧密的标度关系。然而，对于质量介于恒星级黑洞与超大质量黑洞之间的**中等质量黑洞（IMBHs, $10^2 - 10^5 M_\odot$）**，其存在形式、数量密度以及形成机制一直是天体物理领域的未解之谜。
\nIMBHs被认为是早期宇宙中超大质量黑洞的“种子”，其演化路径主要有两种假说：轻种子模型（源自恒星坍缩，质量 $\sim 10-100 M_\odot$）和重种子模型（源自气体云坍缩或直接塌缩，质量 $\sim 10^4-10^5 M_\odot$）。此外，詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）近期在极高红移处发现了质量惊人的大质量黑洞，这迫使理论物理学家重新思考黑洞的成核与早期增长机制。由于早期宇宙直接观测的困难，研究**近邻宇宙中的IMBHs**被视为一种“化石记录”方法，可以为限制黑洞形成理论提供关键约束。
\n然而，IMBH研究面临严峻的观测挑战。与质量巨大的SMBH不同，IMBH的引力辐射和吸积盘辐射较弱，且很难利用传统的动力学方法精确称重。目前常用的黑洞质量估计方法多依赖于基于SMBH经验标度关系的“回声映射”（Reverberation Mapping, RM）或单历元估计法（Single-epoch estimation），但在 $M_{\rm BH} < 10^6 M_\odot$ 的区间内，这些关系的可靠性尚不十分确切。因此，建立基于直接测量（如宽线区动力学）的IMBH样本，对于校准低质量黑洞的质量估算及拓展黑洞-星系标度关系至IMBH区间至关重要。
contribution:
- **项目背景与动机**：针对JWST发现的早期大质量黑洞对黑洞种子形成理论的挑战，利用近邻宇宙的IMBHs作为黑洞演化历史的“化石记录”。
- **构建均匀IMBH样本**：启动了“中等质量黑洞回声映射项目”（IMBH-RM）。通过重新分析文献中的候选体，采用一致的光谱分解和黑洞质量估算方法，构建了来自SDSS的**192个可靠的活跃宽线IMBH候选体**（$z \lesssim 0.3$）。
- **样本质量分布特征**：筛选出的样本主要覆盖 $\log(M_{\rm BH}/M_\odot) < 6$ 的低质量区间，其中包括4个极其有力的 $\log(M_{\rm BH}/M_\odot) < 5$ 的目标源。这一跨越 $10^4-10^6 M_\odot$ 质量范围的样本统计意义显著。
- **科学目标与规划**：项目计划对精选子样本进行回声映射观测，**直接测量宽线区（BLR）和吸积盘的特征尺度**，以获得可靠的黑洞质量。
- **对校准与标度关系的贡献**：未来的测量将为单历元黑洞质量估算提供稳健的**低质量锚点**，并将黑洞-星系标度关系可靠地延伸至IMBH领域，从而为不同的黑洞种子形成场景提供观测限制。
- **未来设施展望**：指出中国空间站巡天望远镜（CSST）的多通道成像仪（MCI）是未来实现这些科学目标（特别是大样本回声映射）的潜力平台。
summary: Recent discoveries with the James Webb Space Telescope of massive black holes at high redshift have highlighted fundamental questions about black hole seed formation and the coevolution of black holes with their host galaxies. Because the initial seed population cannot yet be observed directly, nearby intermediate-mass black holes provide a complementary fossil record of black hole formation and early growth. Motivated by this opportunity, we present the Intermediate-Mass Black Hole Reverberation Mapping (IMBH-RM) project and construct a homogeneous Sloan Digital Sky Survey sample of active broad-line IMBHs by uniformly reanalyzing literature candidates with consistent spectral decomposition and black hole mass estimation. Our sample contains 192 reliable IMBH candidates at $z\lesssim0.3$ with $\log(M_{\rm BH}/M_\odot)<6$, including four particularly compelling sources with $\log(M_{\rm BH}/M_\odot)<5$. The primary goal of IMBH-RM is to obtain reliable black hole masses from direct measurements and characteristic sizes of the broad-line region and accretion disk for a carefully selected subsample. These measurements will provide robust low-mass anchors for calibrating single-epoch black hole mass estimates and extending black hole--galaxy scaling relations into the IMBH regime. By building a statistically meaningful reverberation-mapped sample spanning $10^4-10^6\,M_\odot$, we aim to constrain the local IMBH mass distribution and place observational constraints on competing black hole seed formation scenarios. The future Multi-Channel Imager aboard the Chinese Space-station Survey Telescope provides a particularly promising platform for achieving these goals.

title: Simulation of the electron escape ratio for keV alpha-particle ionization tracks in liquid helium
background_knowledge: 在暗物质直接探测（如DARKSIDE-05、MAJORANA等液氩/液氙/液氦探测器）中，理解放射性背景（特别是氡衰变产生的α粒子）的响应至关重要。α粒子在液态稀有气体中产生电离径迹（ionization tracks），其中一部分初始产生的电子（initial electrons）在重组过程中会逃逸出来（escape），形成可探测的电荷信号。这一“电子逃逸比”（electron escape ratio, $r_{esc}$ 或 $Q_{ion}$）不仅依赖于外加电场，还高度依赖于径迹的能量和空间密度分布（即电离密度）。对于keV量级的反冲核（recoils）或低能α径迹，其径迹结构（track structure）与MeV量级的α粒子有显著差异，直接影响探测器的背景识别能力和核反冲信号重建精度。
contribution:
- **首次精确表征keV量级α径迹的电子逃逸比**：通过基于COMSOL的数值模拟框架，成功计算并提供了此前缺失的keV量级（2, 5, 10 keV）氦中α径迹的电子逃逸比数据，填补了低能径迹物理参数的空白。
- **验证与扩展模拟框架**：采用两阶段模拟策略。Stage I通过复现5.3 MeV α粒子的已有实验数据验证了模型的准确性；Stage II将该模型扩展至keV尺度径迹，证明了该框架在模拟不同能量尺度电离径迹方面的有效性。
- **发现低能径迹的逃逸比显著升高**：模拟结果表明，keV量级径迹的电子逃逸比约为5.3 MeV径迹的 **1.5至2.5倍**，这意味着低能背景事件在探测器中产生的电荷信号比例更高，对能谱重建和背景区分有重要影响。
- **揭示逃逸比与离子密度的线性依赖关系**：分析指出，不同能量（2, 5, 10 keV及5.3 MeV）径迹的逃逸比均与模拟初始时刻（$T_0$）的**离子数密度**呈线性相关，而与**电子数密度**无直接线性依赖关系。这一发现为优化低能事件的响应模型和背景扣除算法提供了关键的物理依据。
summary: The electron escape ratio for 5.3 MeV alpha-particle ionization tracks in liquid helium under varying external electric fields has been measured in several experiments. However, to the best of our knowledge, the corresponding ratio for keV-scale alpha tracks in the same medium has not yet been reported. In this article, we demonstrate for the first time that this ratio can be accurately characterized using COMSOL-based simulations. Our simulation framework was developed in two stages. In Stage I, we aimed to verify consistency between our simulated results and published experimental data for 5.3 MeV alpha particles. Following successful verification in Stage I, we proceeded to Stage II, in which the 5.3 MeV track was replaced by 2, 5, and 10 keV tracks. Our simulated results reveal that (a) keV-scale tracks exhibit electron escape ratios approximately 1.5-2.5 times higher than that of the 5.3 MeV track, and (b) the escape ratios for all track energies (2, 5, 10 keV, and 5.3 MeV) exhibit a linear dependence on the ion number density at the simulation's T0, but not on the electron number density.

title: Overview of multi-conjugate adaptive optics reconstructors
background_knowledge:
自适应光学（Adaptive Optics, AO）是天文学中用于克服地球大气湍流导致的波前畸变、提升地面望远镜分辨率的关键技术。传统单共轭自适应光学（Single Conjugate AO, SC-AO）仅能校正望远镜视场中一个点光源的湍流影响，随着视场偏离该点，校正效果迅速下降，导致视场受限。
\n多共轭自适应光学（Multi-Conjugate AO, MCAO）旨在通过大气层析技术（Atmospheric Tomography）实现对宽视场内湍流扰动的均匀校正。其核心物理图像是将大气湍流分解为不同高度（共轭层）的相位屏。MCAO 系统利用多个信标（Natural Guide Stars, Laser Guide Stars）和波前传感器测量各层湍流的投影，并通过控制多个共轭于不同高度的变形镜（Deformable Mirrors, DMs）来重构并补偿三维体积内的湍流场。
\n在 MCAO 中，“重构器”（Reconstructor）负责处理波前传感器的斜率数据，计算出变形镜所需的校正命令。这是 MCAO 系统的算法核心，其性能直接决定了最终成像的质量、均匀性和校正深度。不同的重构算法在计算复杂度、对测量噪声的鲁棒性、以及对大气湍流模型先验知识的依赖程度上存在显著权衡。
contribution:
本文综述了过去二十年提出的主要多共轭自适应光学（MCAO）重构算法，并对比了其相对优势与局限性。文章将 MCAO 重构器分为四大类进行深入讨论：
- **基于交互矩阵的重构器（Interaction matrix-based reconstructors）**：利用线性代数方法，通过预先测量的交互矩阵（Interaction Matrix, IM）直接求解变形镜命令，适用于静态或准静态湍流场，计算效率较高，但受限于湍流统计特性变化时的鲁棒性。
- **最小方差静态重构器（Minimum-variance static reconstructors）**：基于统计最优估计理论，旨在最小化校正残差的方差。此类方法需要已知大气湍流场的先验统计模型（如功率谱密度），能够在给定测量噪声下提供理论上的最优校正性能，但对模型误差敏感且计算复杂度相对较高。
- **三步重构器（3-step reconstructors）**：一种结构化的重构策略，通常包括波前斜率测量、层析重构和变形镜命令计算等步骤。此类方法可能在特定假设下简化了计算或提高了对局部湍流的适应性，但在整体最优性上可能略逊于全最小方差方法。
- **基于卡尔曼滤波的重构器（Kalman-based reconstructors）**：利用递归状态空间模型，结合时间演化的湍流动态模型（如泰勒冻结流假设）和测量模型，实现对湍流状态的实时最优估计。此类方法能够处理时间相关噪声和动态系统，理论上在时域上具有最优性能，但算法实现复杂，对参数调优要求极高。
\n论文指出，尽管已有部分 MCAO 重构器在现有系统的实测中得以实现，但不同算法在**计算负担**、**对湍流模型先验知识的依赖**以及**宽视场校正均匀性**方面存在显著差异，选择合适重构器需根据具体仪器配置和科学目标进行权衡。
summary: Multi-Conjugate Adaptive Optics (MCAO) systems aim at correcting for the atmospheric turbulence uniformly over wide-field observations. Compared to classical AO, this requires a tomographic reconstruction of the turbulence perturbations, that is to say a reconstruction of the atmosphere in its volume, and the control of several deformable mirrors optically conjugated to various altitudes. During the last two decades, many tomographic reconstructors have been proposed in the AO literature and some have been implemented on sky on existing MCAO systems. This paper presents an overview of MCAO reconstructors. Four categories of reconstructors are considered: i) the reconstructors based on interaction matrix; ii) the minimum-variance static reconstructors; iii) the 3-step recontructors and iv) the Kalman-based reconstructors. We discuss their relative advantages and drawbacks.

title: Mass-dependent multiplicity fraction in low mass stars revealed by Gaia astrometry
background_knowledge: 恒星多重性（Stellar Multiplicity）是理解恒星形成与演化的关键物理量，它直接影响恒星的质量测定、双星演化动力学以及系外行星系统的统计特性。在观测实践中，不同轨道周期的双星系统依赖于不同的探测技术：极短周期系统通常通过径向速度法（Radial Velocity, RV）探测其多普勒频移；长周期宽距对主要通过直接成像法（Direct Imaging）分辨；而中间周期范围（从几天到数千天）的探测长期以来存在盲区，往往依赖于天体测量法（Astrometry）。天体测量法通过精确测量恒星在天空中的位置移动来推断引力摄动。随着Gaia卫星第三数据发布（Gaia DR3）提供了空前精度和覆盖率的宇宙学天体测量数据，利用Gaia发布的各类诊断参数（如轨道加速度、加加速度/jerk、以及单星拟合优度RUWE等）结合前进建模（Forward Modelling）技术，使得系统性约束这一中间周期范围及低质量恒星（M型矮星）群体中双星比例成为可能。
contribution:
- **开发基于Gaia数据的多重性限制框架**：针对传统轨道解算覆盖率低的问题，论文利用**Gaiamock**模拟器构建了一套**前进建模（forward-modelling）框架**。该框架整合了Gaia DR3中所有的天体测量解类型，特别是利用了非轨道解的粗粒度诊断量（如加速度、jerk和RUWE），从而在轨道周期灵敏度上覆盖了远超单纯轨道解的范围。

- **大样本低质量恒星分析**：将上述框架应用于位于50--200 pc范围内的**$366~027$**颗主星（Primary），其质量范围为 **$0.2$--$0.75\,M_\odot$**。该样本包含了比以往多重性研究**数量级更多**的M型矮星，极大地扩展了对低质量恒星双星统计的观测基础。

- **揭示质量依赖的多重性分数新特征**：研究发现，双星/多重星分数与恒星质量的关系并非传统认为的单调递增。结果显示：
  1. 在$0.75\,M_\odot$到$0.4\,M_\odot$区间，多重性分数保持在**约 $45\%$ 的常数水平**，这表明低质量恒星（上部M型矮星）的多重性统计特征与太阳型恒星高度一致，而非随质量下降而降低。
  2. 只有当质量进一步降低至**$0.2\,M_\odot$**时，多重性分数才显著下降至**约 $15\%$**。

- **修正传统理论图像**：该结果**修正了传统的质量--多重性关系（mass--multiplicity relation）**，即不再认为其随质量单调上升。研究证实了多重性分数在$0.4\,M_\odot$以上存在一个“平台期”，这对于理解低质量恒星的形成机制（如碎裂与吸积）及轨道动力学演化具有重要的约束意义。
summary: Stellar multiplicity at different orbital periods is probed by different techniques: radial velocities at the shortest periods, direct imaging at the longest, and astrometry in between. Gaia DR3 provides unprecedented astrometric information to constrain binary populations with periods of tens to thousands of days. Beyond the small fraction of direct orbit solutions, Gaia publishes coarser astrometric diagnostics for all objects, such as on-sky accelerations, jerks, or the single-star goodness-of-fit measure, RUWE. We show that these diagnostics together are sensitive to a far wider range of orbital periods than orbit solutions alone. Built on the Gaiamock emulator, we develop a forward-modelling framework to constrain rates of multiplicity from Gaia data, using all astrometric solution types. We apply this framework to $366~027$ primaries of $0.2$--$0.75\,M_\odot$ between $50$ and $200$ pc, including vastly more M-dwarfs than previous multiplicity studies. For fiducial models of the period and mass-ratio distributions, the inferred multiplicity fraction is approximately constant at ${\sim}45\%$ from the solar-type regime down to $0.4\,M_\odot$, only then dropping to ${\sim}15\%$ by $0.2\,M_\odot$. This mass-multiplicity relationship revises the conventional picture of a monotonically rising mass--multiplicity relation, and aligns the upper M-dwarf regime with solar-type stars rather than placing it on a continuous decline.

title: JWST Reveals a Candidate Supermassive Black Hole Binary at z=4.3 in the Brightest Sub-millimeter Galaxy in COSMOS-Web
background_knowledge: 在宇宙演化的层级结构形成理论中，星系的并合往往伴随着其中心超大质量黑洞（SMBH）的靠近，最终形成超大质量黑洞双星系统（SMBHB）。这一过程对理解星系反馈机制、活动星系核（AGN）的触发以及低频引力波（如未来脉冲星计时阵列探测的目标）的产生源至关重要。然而，在宇宙早期（高红移，如 $z \gtrsim 4$），受限于空间分辨率和光谱信噪比，直接通过光学或近红外光谱分辨出SMBHB的轨道动力学特征极具挑战性。通常，通过光谱分解（如窄线与宽线分离）并分析宽线区（BLR）发射线的速度偏移（velocity offset）和形态，结合星系动力学环境（如气体不稳定性、并合历史），是识别候选SMBHB的重要手段。此外，理解并合诱导的星暴（Starburst）与AGN活动之间的时间延迟及相互作用，是揭示SMBHB形成机制的关键背景知识。
contribution:
- 利用 **JWST/NIRSpec** 对位于 COSMOS 场、红移 $z=4.34$ 的明亮亚毫米星系 **AzTEC-1** 进行光谱观测，确认其存在强 H$\alpha$ 发射、显著的 Balmer 断裂以及高尘埃衰减，指示这是一个年龄为 $100-400$ Myr 的恒星群体，且 **BPT 线比值**证实其中心存在活动星系核（AGN）。
- 通过分解窄线和宽线成分，发现了与系统窄线速度中心存在巨大偏移的 **宽、蓝移 H$\alpha$ 发射线**，其速度偏移量高达 $1245{\,\rm km\,s^{-1}}$，半高全宽（FWHM）约为 $2500{\,\rm km\,s^{-1}}$。结合星系平滑形态和恒星年龄特征（暗示过去的并合诱导星暴），这一观测结果构成了 **候选超大质量黑洞双星系统** 存在的关键证据。
- 在假设低质量黑洞携带宽线区环绕静默主黑洞轨道运行的情景下，研究排除了扩展外流存在的显著证据（2D 光谱、NIRCam 成像及 ALMA 尘埃/气体运动学均未发现外流特征），转而提出 **动力学转矩** 机制：中心气体面密度高且动力学不稳定的气体盘可能通过外部大质量气体云，将并合后的轨道衰减过程从 $\sim10$ Myr 拖延至 $\sim100$ Myr。
- 若该候选双星系统得到进一步确认，AzTEC-1 将成为研究驱动 **低频引力波探测** 相关天体物理过程（特别是早期宇宙大质量星系核中的 SMBHB 动力学）的一个优秀实验室。
summary: We present JWST/NIRSpec PRISM and G395M grating spectroscopy for AzTEC-1, a massive sub-mm bright galaxy at $z=4.34$ in the COSMOS extragalactic field. The PRISM spectrum reveals strong H$α$, a significant Balmer break, and no H$β$ detection, indicating a $100-400$ Myr-old stellar population and high dust attenuation. BPT line ratios indicate the presence of an Active Galactic Nucleus (AGN). Decomposing narrow and broad line components, we recover broad, blueshifted H$α$ with a velocity offset of $1245{\,\rm km\,s^{-1}}$ from the systemic narrow line velocity and with FWHM$\,\sim2500\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}}$. AzTEC-1's smooth morphology and stellar age is suggestive of a past merger-induced starburst period that would have brought in a second supermassive black hole, raising the possibility for a binary supermassive black hole system. In this scenario, we assume that the lower mass black hole hosts a broad line region orbiting a quiescent primary. Evidence for an extended outflow is not found in the 2D spectrum, NIRCam imaging, resolved ALMA observations of dust continuum, or CO, [C II]$_{157\,μ\rm m}$ and [N II]$_{\rm 205\,μm}$ kinematics. AzTEC-1's high central gas mass surface density and dynamically unstable gas disk indicates that massive gas clouds external to the candidate binary SMBH's orbit might have played a role in stalling infall from $\sim10$ Myr to $\sim100$ Myr through dynamical torques, which has been theorized to occur in the nuclei of massive galaxies like AzTEC-1. If the supermassive black hole binary is confirmed, AzTEC-1 would be an excellent laboratory into the astrophysics driving low-frequency gravitational wave detections.

title: Linking neutral gas inflows and outflows to offsets in the star-forming main sequence and mass-metallicity relation
background_knowledge: 星系的演化本质上是重子物质循环（Baryon Cycle）的过程，涉及气体吸积（Inflows）、恒星形成、超新星与活动星系核反馈驱动的气体外流（Outflows）等阶段。这一动态过程直接塑造了星系的关键统计性质，如恒星星系的质量-恒星形成率关系（即主序关系，Star-Forming Main Sequence, SFMS）和质量-金属丰度关系（Mass-Metallicity Relation, MZR）。尽管理论模型广泛预测气体流动通过改变恒星形成效率和稀释或富集气体金属丰度来调节这些关系，但由于气体流动的空间尺度小且速度特征隐蔽，长期缺乏从大样本实测数据建立‘具体气体流动物理状态’与‘宏观缩放关系偏移’之间定量联系的手段。中性氢气体（如通过 Na I D 吸收线探测）作为星系盘或晕中相对较冷的气体成分，其动力学状态为理解星系吸积与反馈阶段提供了独特的观测窗口。
contribution:
- 利用 **DESI DR2** 样本中约 6,000 个具有顺视线（down-the-barrel）方向 Na I D 吸收线测量的恒星形成星系，首次系统建立了实测中性气体流入与流出特征与 SFMS、MZR 偏离度之间的直接联系。
- **流出星系**（$v_{\text{flow}} \leq -50\,\text{km}\,\text{s}^{-1}$）表现出显著增强的比恒星形成率（sSFR 偏高 $0.25$-$0.40\,\text{dex}$）以及较高的中心金属丰度（偏高 $0.04$-$0.06\,\text{dex}$），表明强反馈活动发生在恒星形成极为活跃的峰值阶段。
- **慢流入星系**（$0 < v_{\text{flow}} < 100\,\text{km}\,\text{s}^{-1}$）的 sSFR 同样偏高（$0.20$-$0.30\,\text{dex}$），但**无显著金属丰度偏移**。这暗示这些星系位于 SFMS 上方，其吸积过程可能已发生部分金属增丰或混合，能够维持增强的恒星形成活动而不引发中心气体显著稀释。
- **快流入星系**（$v_{\text{flow}} \geq 100\,\text{km}\,\text{s}^{-1}$）则显示出较弱的恒星形成增强和轻微的金属丰度降低，可能反映不同气体吸积物理机制或观测特征。
- 进一步发现，具有气体流动的星系在 4000 Å 断口强度（$D_n4000$）指标上也表现出**系统性小幅度偏移**，暗示气体吸积与流出活动可能关联着恒星星系的年龄或恒星形成历史特征变化。
- 研究结果支持一种**调控图像（Regulator Picture）**：不同阶段的中性气体流动对应着重子循环中的不同物理过程，是驱动星系缩放关系存在固有散布（Scatter）的重要来源。
summary: Gas inflows and outflows regulate galaxy growth, but direct observational links between measured gas flows and galaxy scaling relations remain limited. Using ~6,000 star-forming galaxies with down-the-barrel Na I D absorption from DESI DR2, we examine how systems with detected neutral-gas inflows and outflows populate the star-forming main sequence (SFMS) and mass-metallicity relation (MZR). Inflow and outflow hosts are compared with stellar-mass- and redshift-matched controls, and with SFMS and MZR fits derived from galaxies without detected gas flows. Outflow hosts (v_flow $\leq$ -50 km s$^{-1}$) show enhanced sSFRs by 0.25-0.40 dex and elevated central metallicities by 0.04-0.06 dex in the lower-redshift sample. Slow inflow hosts (0 $<$ v_flow $<$ 100 km s$^{-1}$) show similarly enhanced sSFRs of 0.20-0.30 dex, but no significant metallicity offset, while fast inflow hosts (v_flow $\geq$ 100 km s$^{-1}$) show weaker SFR enhancement and modestly lower metallicities. Together, these trends support a regulator picture in which neutral gas flows trace different phases of the baryon cycle. Slow inflow hosts lie above the SFMS, consistent with accretion sustaining enhanced star formation without strong central metallicity dilution. This may indicate that inflowing gas is already metal-enriched or has mixed or enriched over extended timescales. By contrast, outflow hosts lie near the upper 1{$σ$} SFMS envelope, consistent with feedback regulating subsequent growth. Gas-flow hosts also show small but systematic offsets in the narrow 4000 Å break strength ($D_n$4000) relative to controls matched in redshift, stellar mass and SFR. Our results show that neutral gas flows are associated with population-level offsets from the SFMS and MZR, consistent with a baryon-cycle contribution to scaling-relation scatter.

title: BICEP/Keck XXII: Analysis of the South Pole Atmosphere for CMB Observations
background_knowledge: 宇宙微波背景辐射（CMB）是大爆炸后约38万年遗留下来的热辐射，其微小各向异性是探测早期宇宙物理、验证标准宇宙学模型（如ΛCDM）以及寻找原初引力波证据的关键探针。地基CMB观测通常选择在南极、阿塔卡马沙漠等极端干燥的高海拔台址进行，以降低大气水蒸气对毫米波段的吸收与发射噪声。然而，即使是在最干燥的台址，大气中残留的水蒸气（$H_2O$）仍会随时间和空间波动，产生随时间变化的大气辐射。这种波动不仅增加观测噪声，更关键的是会通过望远镜光学系统的缺陷或指向误差，将强烈的温度信号泄漏至极化信号中（即Temperature-to-Polarization Leakage），成为限制高精度CMB极化测量（特别是原初引力波B模探测）的主要系统误差来源。因此，精确表征大气水蒸气的时空特性及其对探测器数据的影响，是提升地基CMB实验灵敏度与系统精度的核心环节。
contribution:
- **部署水蒸气辐射计（WVR）进行长期监测**：论文分析了部署于南极、与BICEP系列望远镜共址观测长达九年的水蒸气辐射计性能，全面表征了南极大气水蒸气的时空波动特性。
- **揭示大气水蒸气的相干输运机制**：研究证实了南极台址上空存在**相干的风驱动水蒸气结构输运**现象，明确了大气波动的物理来源与空间相关性。
- **建立大气波动与探测器数据的强关联**：结果表明，CMB探测器时间流（timestreams）中的波动与大气水蒸气波动具有**高度相关性**。这一发现为实验中用于消除大气噪声的**基线滤波程序（baseline filtering）**提供了独立的物理依据。
- **提出抑制极化泄漏的新路径**：基于上述相关性，论文提出了一条新的技术途径，用于探测并减轻当前限制地基CMB极化测量精度的**温度到极化的泄漏（temperature-to-polarization leakage）**，有助于提升原初引力波等微弱信号的探测能力。
summary: The South Pole is among the driest sites on Earth, and the resulting high atmospheric transparency makes it an excellent site for millimeter-wave astronomical observations. Nevertheless, for bolometric surveys of the cosmic microwave background (CMB), fluctuations in line-of-sight water vapor drive variable atmospheric emission, which has a significant impact on survey sensitivity. We have deployed a water vapor radiometer (WVR) to characterize these fluctuations in space and time and to compare atmospheric and CMB signals with other sites. This WVR has been monitoring conditions from the South Pole over the past nine years, co-located and co-observing with the BICEP series of telescopes. In this work, we analyze the performance of the WVR and the characteristics of the South Pole atmosphere and demonstrate coherent wind-driven transport of water vapor structures across the site. We show that fluctuations in CMB detector timestreams are well correlated with fluctuations in atmospheric water vapor, providing independent justification for baseline filtering procedures used to remove these fluctuations and providing a new pathway to detect and mitigate the temperature-to-polarization leakage that currently limits the precision of ground-based CMB polarization measurements.

title: Inflationary Magnetogenesis with f(R) Gravity: Dynamics, Constraints, and Observational Signatures during Reheating
background_knowledge: 原初磁场（Primordial Magnetic Fields）的存在已被射电天文学和伽马射线观测所支持，它们可能作为种子场演变为观测到的星系及星系团中的强磁场。在标准宇宙学模型中，由于电磁作用具有共形不变性，原初量子涨落难以在暴胀期间放大并留存至今。Ratra模型通过引入标量场依赖的耦合函数打破这一对称性，是目前最成功的原初磁化机制之一。然而，标准广义相对论框架下的模型往往面临强耦合、反作用过大或与宇宙微波背景辐射（CMB）各向同性观测冲突等问题。修正引力理论（如 $f(R)$ 引力）提供了扩展此类模型的可能性。此外，暴胀结束后的再加热（Reheating）时期以及随后大尺度结构形成阶段的磁流体力学（MHD）湍流（特别是逆级联过程）对磁场的强度与相干长度有决定性影响，是连接早期宇宙物理与现代观测的关键环节。
contribution:
- **理论框架扩展**：将经典的 Ratra 原初磁化模型推广至非最小耦合的 $f(R)$ 引力框架，通过在拉格朗日量中引入形式为 $f^2(
\beta) F_{
\beta}F^{
\beta}$ 的项，有效打破电磁作用在弯曲时空中的共形不变性，从而在暴胀期间放大原初磁场。
- **解析谱推导与约束应用**：聚焦于暴胀结束后的**再加热（Reheating）时期**，构建跨越暴胀-再加热转变期的标度因子与耦合函数的分段幂律演化模型，推导出了磁场和电场均值密度谱的解析表达式。在此基础上，施加了三项关键理论约束：**强耦合条件**、**反作用约束**以及**CMB各向同性要求**，以限定模型参数空间。
- **数值预测与参数依赖**：针对不同的暴胀能标 $H_f$ 和再加热温度 $T_r$ 组合，通过数值计算给出了当前宇宙中磁场强度 $B_0$ 和相干长度 $L_{c0}$ 的预测值。
- **MHD湍流效应整合**：纳入了再加热后磁流体力学（MHD）湍流的非线性效应，特别是**逆级联（inverse transfer）过程**。结果显示，该过程显著增强了磁场的相干长度（可达 **$0.1$ Mpc**），但导致磁场强度降低了几个数量级。
- **观测一致性验证**：通过与射电观测及费米伽马射线空间望远镜（Fermi-LAT）数据对比，确立了暴胀能标 $H_f$、再加热温度 $T_r$、参数 $\beta$ 以及暴胀/再加热e-folds数 $N_f, N_r$ 之间的**严格联合约束**。证明该框架能同时满足理论自洽性与当前观测限制，为原初磁化提供了一个可行的理论方案。
summary: Inflationary magnetogenesis provides a promising mechanism for generating primordial large-scale magnetic fields, but faces challenges. In this paper, we extend the Ratra model to a non-minimal $f(R)$ gravity framework, appearing in the Lagrangian in the form $f^2(η) F_{μν}F^{μν}$, to break the conformal invariance of the standard electromagnetic action. Focusing on the post-inflationary reheating epoch, we derive analytic expressions for the magnetic and electric energy density spectra by constructing a broken-power-law evolution for the scale factor and the coupling function across the inflation-to-reheating transition. Three key theoretical constraints are imposed on the model parameter space: the strong coupling condition, the backreaction constraint, and the CMB isotropy requirement. Through numerical calculations, we obtain predictions for the present-day magnetic field strength $B_0$ and coherence length $L_{c0}$ for various combinations of the inflationary energy scale $H_f$ and the reheating temperature $T_r$. We further incorporate the nonlinear effects of magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) turbulence after reheating, including the inverse transfer process, which significantly enhances the coherence length (up to $0.1$ Mpc) while reducing the field strength by several orders of magnitude. By comparing with observational constraints from radio observations and Fermi-LAT gamma-ray data, we demonstrate that the inflationary energy scale $H_f$, the reheating temperature $T_r$, the parameter $β$, and the e-folds numbers $N_f$, $N_r$ must satisfy stringent joint constraints. This work provides a viable theoretical framework for inflationary magnetogenesis that simultaneously satisfies theoretical consistency conditions and current observational bounds.

title: Curving X-ray detectors for astrophysics applications
background_knowledge: X射线天文学依赖于高能光子与物质的相互作用，其观测核心难点在于X射线的折射率接近1，无法使用传统透镜，必须依靠掠射式光学系统（如Wolter I型镜面）。这种几何设计导致焦面并非平面，而是一个具有特定曲率的曲面（场曲）。为了匹配光学系统的完美焦面以获得最佳成像质量，探测器传感器也必须具备相应的曲率。传统方案是使用多个小面积平板传感器拼接以近似曲面，但这引入了接缝、对准误差及系统复杂性。CCD（电荷耦合器件）和CMOS有源像素传感器（APS）是X射线探测的主流技术，其中背照式（Back-Illuminated, BI）CCD因在软X射线波段具有更高的量子效率而备受青睐。在空间任务中，探测器的热稳定性、辐射损伤导致的暗电流增加以及光谱分辨率是衡量仪器性能的关键指标。
contribution: - 提出并验证了一种通过直接弯曲大面积传感器本身而非拼接多个小平板的技术路线，以匹配下一代X射线光学系统的曲面焦面，旨在提升成像质量并简化系统架构。 - 基于MIT Lincoln Laboratory的技术，成功将具有良好X射线响应特性的背照式大格式CCD弯曲至半径为$2.5$米的曲率。 - 实验数据证实，**弯曲过程未导致暗电流（Dark Current）的显著增加**，且传感器在$0.3-6\ \text{keV}$能段内的**光谱性能保持优异**。 - 该技术实现了RMS曲率偏差**小于$1$微米**的高精度，证明了**功能性大格式弯曲X射线传感器的工程可行性**，并指出该工艺可进一步扩展至有源像素传感器（APS）等其他硅基探测器架构。
summary: Next-generation X-ray optics will revolutionize high-energy astrophysics, yet they present several challenges to design a complementary focal plane. In particular, the focal surface is curved, requiring many small, flat sensors to achieve a large field. We present work building on MIT Lincoln Laboratory technology to curve the sensor itself, improving image quality and reducing complexity. Applying this technology to back-illuminated, large-format CCDs having well-characterized X-ray response, we describe the process and report success curving functional BI CCDs to a 2.5-m radius of curvature, achieving RMS curvature deviations less than 1 micron. We confirm that there is no appreciable increase in dark current and that the spectroscopic performance across the 0.3-6 keV band remains excellent. These results demonstrate that curved, large-format X-ray sensors are realizable, and the process can be extended to silicon detectors with other architectures, including active pixel sensors.

title: EWOCS-IX: JWST/NIRCam observations of Westerlund 2 - Identification of candidate substellar members
background_knowledge: 在银河系及邻近宇宙（Local Universe）的研究中，大质量年轻星团是探索恒星形成理论的关键实验室。这类星团（如Westerlund 2）具有极高的恒星密度和强烈的离子化辐射场，为研究褐矮星（Brown Dwarfs, BDs）及次恒星级天体（substellar objects）的形成机制提供了独特的环境样本。褐矮星的质量范围通常介于巨行星与最低质量恒星之间（约 $0.013 - 0.075 M_\odot$），其形成过程可能类似于恒星坍缩，也可能类似于行星吸积。然而，在高密度、强辐射的极端环境下，次恒星星团的质量函数（IMF）下限、褐矮星与星周盘（circumstellar disks）的存活率以及环境对次恒星演化的具体影响，仍是当前天体物理学的未解之谜。利用空间望远镜（如JWST）的红外波段观测能力，结合多波段测光与光谱能量分布（SED）拟合技术，已成为深入探究这些低质量天体特性的主流研究范式。
contribution:
- **开创性深场观测与样本识别**：利用JWST/NIRCam在1.15至4.1 $\mu\mathrm{m}$ 范围内的4个宽带和6个中频带滤波器对Westerlund 2 (Wd2) 进行了深度观测，通过PSF测光（DOLPHOT）和SED拟合，成功识别出353个次恒星星候选体。该观测的深度达到了约 $0.015-0.02 M_\odot$，提供了迄今对超大质量星团次恒星群体最深的视角。
- **成员性确认与低污染率**：在赫兹普龙-罗素图（HR diagram）上，绝大多数候选体（301个）位于10 Myr等时线之上，被定义为“强候选体”。与对照场比较表明，在低至 $\sim0.01-0.015 M_\odot$ 的质量范围内，强候选体样本的前景/背景污染率小于5%，证实了这些天体作为Wd2真实成员的身份。
- **次恒星盘存活率的量化**：研究发现了73个表现出红外过量的候选体，表明其拥有星周盘。这些天体在去红移的颜色-颜色图中占据了预期的红外过量轨迹。在F410M滤镜检测到的候选体中，**约 $27.7^{+3.4}_{-3.2}\%$ 的天体具有盘特征**。这一比例为在强辐射场下盘物理演化模型提供了重要的观测约束。
- **建立高置信度样本库**：该工作产出了一份表征良好的Wd2次恒星星候选体目录，为未来通过光谱学手段进一步确认成员性以及深入研究高密度、强辐射环境下褐矮星的形成与演化奠定了基础。
summary: [Abridged] Investigating substellar populations in young massive clusters offers crucial insights into the formation of brown dwarfs (BDs) and the role of environmental conditions in shaping their properties. Westerlund 2 (Wd2), as one of the nearest dense and massive clusters in the Milky Way, represents an ideal laboratory for studying the effects of high stellar density and ionizing radiation from massive stars on BD formation. This paper presents deep JWST/NIRCam observations of Wd2 in a large number of filters between 1.15 and 4.1 $μm$. Our analysis focuses on identifying and characterizing the BD population within the cluster. We carried out PSF photometry on deep JWST/NIRCam data obtained in 4 wide and 6 medium-band filters, using DOLPHOT. The resulting catalog was used to identify BD candidates in Wd2 through spectral energy distribution (SED) fitting with atmospheric models. The 50\% detection limit of our NIRCam catalog is $\sim$0.015-0.02 $M_\odot$, at the distance, age, and extinction of Wd2, providing the deepest view of a supermassive star cluster to date. We identify 353 substellar candidates. Most candidates (301) lie above the 10 Myr isochrone in the Hertzsprung--Russell diagram consistent with cluster membership, which are defined as strong candidates. Comparison with a control field indicates a contamination level of $\lesssim$5\% for the strong candidate sample down to masses of $\sim$0.01--0.015~$M_\odot$. We identify 73 candidates exhibiting infrared excess indicative of circumstellar disks. These objects occupy the expected infrared-excess locus in de-reddened color diagrams and represent $27.7^{+3.4}_{-3.2}$\% of the candidates detected in F410M. The resulting catalog provides a well-characterized sample for future spectroscopic confirmation and subsequent studies of the substellar population of Wd2.

title: 3.5-meter Segmented-Mirror Robotic Space Telescope Mission White Paper III. Key Scientific Mission: Exoplanet Science with a Coronagraph
background_knowledge: 系外行星探测与表征是现代天体物理最活跃的前沿之一。在观测手段上，凌星法（Transit Photometry）和径向速度法（Radial Velocity）主要用于行星发现，但受限于信噪比和物理模型简并，难以直接获取行星大气的精细成分。直接成像（Direct Imaging）结合高对比度日冕仪（Coronagraph）技术，能够阻挡恒星光晕，通过观测行星反射的恒星光线，直接获取行星的光谱特征（如反照率、分子吸收线等）。然而，由于系外行星的光度通常比其宿主恒星低 5-10 个数量级，直接成像技术长期受到衍射极限（$\lambda/D$）和波前误差（Wavefront Error）的制约。随着望远镜口径的增大（如 3.5 米级空间望远镜）以及波前传感与控制（Wavefront Sensing and Control, WS&C）技术的成熟，观测视界从最近的几颗恒星扩展至更远的类地行星（Earth-like planets）和类木行星（Jupiter analogs），从而能够统计邻近恒星的行星系统分布及其宜居性特征。
contribution:
该白皮书定义了基于 3.5 米分段镜面空间望远镜（3.5-meter Segmented-Mirror Robotic Space Telescope）的高对比度日冕仪载荷的系外行星科学任务。其核心贡献与发现预测包括：
- **观测架构整合**：确立了从初始设计阶段就将光学接口、波前传感与控制、指向稳定性及日冕仪观测所需的操作软件深度整合的观测系统架构。
- **优先观测策略**：通过优先观测最近的恒星系统，将其作为行星探索的最佳实验室，并以此界定未来星际探测任务的最可能目的地。
- **反射光成像极限界定**：量化了衍射极限下的探测范围，指出该望远镜可在 **10--15 pc** 距离内对 1 AU 轨道附近的行星进行反射光成像，而在 **50--80 pc** 距离内探测类木行星。
- **大气光谱与宜居性研究**：在此视距内，望远镜能够获取气态巨行星的大气反射光谱，对年轻系统和星周盘进行巡天观测，并为未来大型空间任务提供关于行星宜居性和生物标志物（biosignature）探测的技术储备与参考。
- **宽视场协同观测**：利用宽视场成像仪与日冕仪协同工作，执行凌星光度测量，从而统计行星发生率（occurrence-rate statistics）并长期监测恒星的磁活动，以构建对邻近恒星邻居的系统普查（systematic census），为系外行星科学提供长效参考基准。
summary: This volume defines the exoplanet science program enabled by the dedicated high-contrast coronagraph in the baseline science payload of the 3.5-meter Segmented-Mirror Robotic Space Telescope. The observatory architecture incorporates the optical interfaces, wavefront sensing and control, pointing stability, and operations software required for coronagraphic observations from the outset. The observing strategy gives priority to the nearest stellar systems because they provide the most accessible laboratories for planetary exploration and the most likely destinations of future interstellar missions. The diffraction limit sets a reflected-light horizon of roughly 10--15 pc for planets at 1 AU and roughly 50--80 pc for Jupiter analogs. Within those horizons, the telescope can image nearby giant planets, obtain reflected-light spectra of their atmospheres, survey young systems and circumstellar disks, and support the habitability and biosignature programs that larger future missions will pursue. The wide-field imager complements the coronagraph through transit photometry, occurrence-rate statistics, and long-term monitoring of stellar magnetic activity. A systematic census of the nearest stellar neighbors provides a lasting reference for exoplanet science and future space exploration.

title: 3.5-meter Segmented-Mirror Robotic Space Telescope Mission White Paper I. Overall Architecture and Scientific Mission
background_knowledge: 天基空间望远镜旨在消除大气湍流和吸收的影响，从而实现地面观测难以企及的衍射极限分辨率、稳定的光度和大视场覆盖。在 $0.2-1.5$ 微米（涵盖紫外至近红外波段）进行观测，能够突破大气截止，对宇宙中的暂现源、恒星物理以及系外行星大气特征进行高精度探测。现代空间天文任务的设计范式正从单一目标专用型向“通用型、高敏捷、模块化”转变。特别是针对引力波电磁对应体、快速演化暂现源等时域天文学目标，要求望远镜具备快速指向能力和极高的时间分辨率。此外，随着系外行星搜寻进入直接成像与大气表征阶段，高对比度日冕仪技术成为衡量下一代空间天文台科学竞争力的关键指标。此类 $3.5$ 米级望远镜通常采用分段镜面技术，在控制发射成本的同时，追求宽平视场上的高斯特雷尔比（Strehl Ratio），并采用日地 L2 点等稳定轨道，以构建全天候、高灵敏度的多波段观测平台。
contribution: - **提出整体架构与性能目标**：规划了一台工作在 $0.2-1.5$ 微米波段的 $3.5$ 米分段镜空间望远镜，采用优化卡塞格林光路，在宽平视场上实现衍射极限性能，**633 nm 处斯特雷尔比大于 0.8**。
summary: A 3.5-meter segmented-mirror robotic space telescope is under study as a space-based observatory for precision astrophysical observations and rapid-response transient astronomy in the 0.2-1.5 micron wavelength range. The telescope adopts a Cassegrain optical configuration optimized to deliver diffraction-limited performance across a wide, flat focal plane, achieving a Strehl ratio greater than 0.8 at 633 nm. The proposed scientific payload includes a Wide-field Camera (WC), a spectroscopic instrument, and an optional Exoplanet Imaging Coronagraph. The Wide-field Camera (WC) provides multi-wavelength imaging and high-cadence time-series photometry over a field of view ranging from 10'X10' to 30'X30'. The spectroscopic configuration and resolving power remain under study to accommodate the requirements of the principal science programs. An optional Exoplanet Imaging Coronagraph is being investigated for high-contrast imaging of nearby planetary systems, with performance goals extending toward raw contrasts of approximately 10^(-8) and improved post-processed performance. Candidate orbital configurations, including Earth orbit and the Sun-Earth L2 region, are currently being evaluated. Planned investigations include gravitational-wave counterparts, rapidly evolving transients, Type Ia supernova cosmology, direct imaging of exoplanets, and exoplanet atmospheric spectroscopy. Although driven by these core scientific objectives, the observatory is conceived as a general-purpose facility providing open-access observing time to the international scientific community. This paper presents the preliminary architecture, performance goals, and scientific mission of the proposed 3.5-meter space telescope.

title: Constraining reionization-era Ly$α$ escape with JELS-MUSE: a highly complete H$α$-selected sample at $z\sim6.1$
background_knowledge: 在宇宙大爆炸后的数亿年间，中性氢气体主导着宇宙，直到第一代恒星和星系发出紫外线辐射将其电离，这一时期被称为‘再电离时期’（Epoch of Reionization, EoR）。莱曼α（Lyman-alpha, Lyα）光子是探测这一时期的关键示踪器，但其在传播过程中极易被星际介质（ISM）和星系际介质（IGM）中的中性氢吸收或散射。目前，观测到的Lyα光度函数在再电离后期显著下降，但这究竟是由于星系内部Lyα逃逸分数（$f_{\rm esc}^{\rm Ly\alpha}$）的固有变化，还是由于IGM中性氢比例上升导致的遮蔽效应，一直难以区分。为了厘清这一问题，需要独立于红移演化，直接测量高红移星系本征的Lyα逃逸特性。通常，$f_{\rm esc}^{\rm Ly\alpha}$定义为观测到的Lyα光度与去尘埃修正的Hα光度之比，然而Lyα的高红移探测受限于仪器灵敏度及IGM的强吸收。
contribution:
- 利用JWST发射线巡天（JELS）与VLT/MUSE深场数据，成功构建了一个包含24个$z \approx 6.1$星系的**高完备Hα选择样本**，为再电离末期Lyα逃逸特性的研究提供了独特的基准。
- 测量得到**Lyα发射体比例为 $X_{\rm Ly\alpha} = 33 \pm 12\%$**（以EW(Lyα) > $25 \, \mathring{\rm{A}}$为判据），且通过反Kaplan-Meier存活分析对未探测源进行统计处理，得出平均逃逸分数 **$\langle f_{\rm esc}^{\rm Ly\alpha} \rangle = 0.07^{+0.04}_{-0.03}$**。
- 结合再电离模拟发现该样本内的IGM透射率差异不大，因此推断**$f_{\rm esc}^{\rm Ly\alpha}$的巨大散射源于ISM驱动的本质差异**，而非周围中性氢分布的不均匀性。
- 揭示了高逃逸分数与星系物理性质的关联：**较高$f_{\rm esc}^{\rm Ly\alpha}$的星系倾向于具有较低的星云尘埃消光、较蓝的紫外斜率和较低的恒星质量**。
- 证实Lyα的逃逸机制与**局部低柱密度ISM通道**（可能由反馈调节形成）密切相关，为解释再电离末期Lyα可见度的下降提供了重要的本征物理基线，有助于分离IGM遮蔽与ISM物理过程的影响。
summary: The Ly$α$ escape fraction, $f_{\rm{esc}}^{\rm{Ly}α}$, probes both the interstellar medium (ISM) conditions governing ionizing photon escape and the rising neutral fraction of the IGM through the Epoch of Reionization (EoR). Characterising the intrinsic, ISM-driven distribution of $f_{\rm{esc}}^{\rm{Ly}α}$ before IGM attenuation becomes dominant is essential to interpret the observed decline in Ly$α$ visibility through the EoR. We present $f_{\rm{esc}}^{\rm{Ly}α}$ measurements for a highly complete, H$α$-flux-limited sample of 24 star-forming galaxies at $z \approx 6.1$, drawn from the JWST Emission Line Survey (JELS) and observed in Ly$α$ with VLT/MUSE as part of the JELS-MUSE Large Area Survey. We detect Ly$α$ in 12 of 24 sources and a Ly$α$ emitter fraction of $X_{\rm{Ly}α} = 33 \pm 12$ per cent using the canonical EW(Ly$α$) $> 25 \, \mathring{\rm{A}}$ definition. Incorporating non-detections via reverse Kaplan-Meier survival analysis yields $\langle f_{\rm{esc}}^{\rm{Ly}α} \rangle = 0.07^{+0.04}_{-0.03}$, consistent with an independent stacked-flux estimate of $0.08^{+0.02}_{-0.02}$. Using reionization simulations matched to the area, depth, and redshift range of our survey, we find that all galaxies are expected to experience broadly similar IGM transmission, so we postulate that the large scatter in $f_{\rm{esc}}^{\rm{Ly}α}$ reflects genuine ISM-driven variance rather than differences in the surrounding IGM. Among the detections, higher $f_{\rm{esc}}^{\rm{Ly}α}$ galaxies tend to have lower nebular dust attenuation, bluer UV slopes, and lower stellar mass, consistent with feedback-regulated escape through localised, low-column-density ISM channels around star-forming regions. These results benchmark intrinsic Ly$α$ escape at the end of reionization, against which IGM suppression at $z > 7$ can be interpreted.

title: An updated census of the Vast Polar Structure member galaxies
background_knowledge: 在银河系卫星星系的研究领域中，传统的层级冷暗物质（LCDM）模型预测卫星星系应呈现各向同性的空间分布和随机取向的轨道角动量。然而，近二十年的观测揭示了一种被称为“平面子结构”（Planar Substructures, PSSs）或“卫星星系平面”的现象，其中最著名的例子是围绕银河系的 Vast Polar Structure (VPOS) 和围绕仙女座星系（M31）的 Great Plane of Andromeda (GPoA)。VPOS 是一个由矮星系组成的薄盘状结构，其平面几乎垂直于银河系主盘。这种高度有序的动力学分布对 LCDM 的随机性预期构成了挑战（即“平面问题”），促使天文学家重新审视局部宇宙中星系形成的环境依赖、潮汐相互作用以及暗物质晕内卫星分布的非随机性。为了准确描述这些结构的几何特征和成员构成，需要依赖高精度的位置数据（如 Gaia 任务提供的自视差）和径向速度测量来确定卫星星系的相位空间坐标，进而通过计算轨道极点（orbital poles）来甄别成员星系。
contribution: - 构建了目前最大规模的 **VPOS 成员星系普查**，基于文献中提供位置与运动学数据的 73 个银河系矮星系样本进行分析。- 通过计算轨道极点，识别出 **22 个 VPOS 成员**，其中包括 12 个银河系直接卫星星系、1 个大麦哲伦云（LMC）本身，以及 9 个 LMC 的卫星星系。这一统计结果将已知的 VPOS 成员数量增加了近 50%。- 发现了 6 个新的共面矮星系成员：**Delve 4, Kim 1, Kim 3, Eridanus III, Pictor II, 和 YMCA-1**（其中 3 个为银河系卫星，3 个为 LMC 卫星）。- 动力学分析显示，除了 **Bootes III, Kim 1, 和 Sculptor** 之外，所有确认在平面上的矮星系均表现出 **共转（co-rotating）** 特征，进一步强化了 VPOS 结构的动力学有序性。- 根据更新后的成员列表，重新评估了 VPOS 的结构参数，证实了其显著的 **扁平几何特征**（轴比 $c/a \sim 0.27$）和极薄的空间分布（厚度约 $\sim 15$ kpc）。
summary: The Vast Polar Structure (VPOS) is a thin, planar arrangement of dwarf galaxies oriented almost perpendicular to the Milky Way (MW) disc. Since its discovery, the census of VPOS member galaxies has progressively expanded thanks to continuous findings of new dwarfs in the vicinity of the MW and increasingly precise measurements of their phase-space coordinates. In this work, we present the largest census to date of VPOS member galaxies, building on a sample of 73 MW dwarfs for which positional and kinematic data are available in the literature. Based on their orbital poles, we identify 22 VPOS members: 12 MW satellites, the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC), and 9 LMC satellites. With the exception of Bootes III, Kim 1, and Sculptor, all the on-plane dwarfs are co-rotating. Our revised census increases the known VPOS member population by nearly 50%, introducing Delve 4, Kim 1, Kim 3, Eridanus III, Pictor II, and YMCA-1 (3 MW and 3 LMC satellites, respectively) as new on-plane dwarfs. From this updated census, we revise the structural parameters of the VPOS, confirming its planar ($c/a \sim$0.27) and remarkably thin ($\sim$15 kpc) nature.

title: Empirical Near-Infrared Spectral Templates from SPHEREx: Disentangling AGN and Host-Galaxy Emission
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）与宿主星系的辐射分离是理解星系演化与黑洞共演化（co-evolution）的核心难题。在光学波段，宿主星系的恒星连续谱与 AGN 的吸积盘辐射往往混杂，导致难以准确提取黑洞吸积率等物理参数。近红外（NIR）波段在此方面具有独特优势：宿主星系的光度主要由年老恒星主导，受尘埃消光影响较小；而 AGN 的辐射主要来自被尘埃加热的环形结构（torus），其特征为随波长变化的幂律谱（hot/warm dust continuum）及特定的发射线。然而，长期以来缺乏高保真度、覆盖 NIR 全波段（特别是 2.5-5.0 $μm$ 这一中红外过渡区）的经验性光谱模板。传统的物理模型往往假设过于理想化的几何结构，而纯统计方法又难以区分复杂的混合光谱成分。大规模光谱巡天（如 SPHEREx）的出现，结合机器学习中的矩阵分解与正演模型技术，为解决这一问题提供了从数据驱动角度分离天体辐射成分的新范式。
contribution:
- **开发数据驱动的分解框架**：提出了一个结合**加权非负矩阵分解**（weighted non-negative matrix factorization）与**正演模型**（forward modeling）的框架，利用 SPHEREx 在北黄极（NEP）视场中的观测数据，从 2,777 个正常星系和 1,064 个 AGN 中学习经验性静止系光谱模板。

- **构建 NIR 多组分字典**：生成了一个包含 14 个分量的光谱字典（7 个星系模板与 7 个 AGN 模板）。这些模板不仅覆盖了恒星群体连续谱和气体星云发射，还精确捕捉了 AGN 的发射线特征以及**温热尘埃环连续谱**（warm and hot torus continua），实现了光谱成分的可加性操作分解。

- **验证宿主-AGN 分离的可靠性**：通过对比推断出的近红外宿主星系比例，发现其与 SDSS 光谱和 HSC 成像的分解结果存在显著相关性（Pearson $r=0.68$ 和 $r=0.59$）。这一相关性与 SDSS 和 HSC 独立结果间的相关性（$r=0.66$）相当，有力支持了该方法在**分离 AGN 与宿主星系辐射**方面的可靠性。

- **高精度红移测量与分类**：在 NEP 深场中，该套模板能以极高精度恢复红移，93.0% 的星系和 93.5% 的 AGN 满足拟合红移与光谱红移之差 $|z_{\rm fit}-z_{\rm spec}| < 0.01$。此外，该分类器能以 **81.3%** 的准确率区分星系、窄线 AGN 和宽线 AGN。

- **填补 NIR 模板空缺并辅助大视场巡天**：该研究直接从巡天光谱光度数据中学习，填补了长波 NIR 及中红外（$>2.5 μm$）缺乏经验性模板的空白。同时，NIR 系数被证明能有效识别 DESI 光谱分类或红移测量中的可疑样本，展示了 **SPHEREx 作为全天空巡天与光学光谱巡天（如 DESI）之间互补性**。
summary: SPHEREx conducts the first all-sky near-infrared spectral survey over 0.75-5.0 $μ$m, spanning the transition from host-galaxy starlight to AGN-heated torus emission and enabling spectroscopic identification of active galactic nuclei (AGNs). We develop a data-driven framework combining weighted non-negative matrix factorization with forward modeling to learn empirical rest-frame templates from 2,777 normal galaxies and 1,064 AGNs in the North Ecliptic Pole (NEP) field. The resulting 14-component dictionary contains seven galaxy templates spanning stellar-population continua and nebular emission and seven AGN templates capturing emission lines and warm and hot torus continua, providing an additive, operational decomposition. Inferred near-infrared host fractions correlate with independent SDSS spectral and HSC imaging decompositions (at Pearson $r=0.68$ and $r=0.59$), comparable to the SDSS-HSC correlation ($r=0.66$) and supporting the reliability of the AGN-host separation. In the NEP deep field, the same templates recover redshifts with $|z_{\rm fit}-z_{\rm spec}| < 0.01$ for 93.0% of galaxies and 93.5% of AGNs and distinguish galaxies, narrow-line AGNs, and broad-line AGNs with 81.3% accuracy. At all-sky depth, classification retains 72.9% accuracy. The near-infrared coefficients also flag questionable DESI spectral classifications and redshifts, showing how SPHEREx complements optical spectroscopy. Learned directly from survey spectrophotometry and extending beyond the $K$ band, this empirical dictionary fills a long-standing gap in near-to-mid-infrared templates and provides a data-driven foundation for population-scale studies of AGN activity and its connection to host galaxies across the SPHEREx all-sky survey.

title: Dark Matter Halo Tumbling Induced by Torques from Massive Mergers
background_knowledge: 在$\\text{\Lambda}\text{CDM}$宇宙学框架下，暗物质晕并非静止不动，其形状（由二阶矩或四极矩描述）会在引力势中缓慢进动，这种现象被称为**“图形旋转”（Figure Rotation）**。图形旋转主要源于宇宙网中大尺度潮汐力场对晕的持续剪切作用。由于该运动相对独立于重子物理反馈，且发生在绝大多数（约$80\%$）的孤立晕中，因此被视为检验$\\text{\Lambda}\text{CDM}$模型及理解暗晕动力学演化的重要探针。然而，星系并合等剧烈的动力学事件可能通过强力矩破坏晕的原有旋转状态，使得通过观测图形旋转来重构早期宇宙环境变得复杂。
contribution:
- 利用孤立 $N-$体模拟及包含银河系类似天体的 $6$ 个 TNG50 暗物质晕，研究了**大质量并合事件**对暗物质晕图形旋转的影响。
- 在孤立演化模拟中，发现大质量并合引发了晕在两个阶段的显著旋转：**卫星落入时的快速瞬态阶段**（图案速度为 $10^\circ-60^\circ \, \text{Gyr}^{-1}$）以及**并合后的稳态进动阶段**（图案速度为 $2^\circ-40^\circ \, \text{Gyr}^{-1}$，持续时间至少 $6-8 \, \text{Gyr}$）。
- 进动状态取决于落入卫星的轨迹；即使是**无轨道角动量的径向并合**也能诱发图形旋转，表明**潮汐力矩**是导致旋转的主要驱动机制。
